description:
Our flat is pretty quiet and peaceful, although it is in the heart of Galata. The flat is just a few steps away from Galata Tower and Karaköy.

The flat designed to provide all your needs. If you want, you can work from home with high-speed internet or cook for dinner or read a book peacefully in silence with high consantration.

Out of the building, there are a lot of boutique cafes to eat something and a lot of local market for shooping

reviews.text:
5/5 – Perfect stay near Galata Tower
Our stay was amazing! The apartment is just a 5-minute walk from Galata Tower and surrounded by shops, restaurants, and convenience stores that stay open very late. It’s also super close to the main road, bus station, train station, and the water—honestly a perfect location for exploring Istanbul.
The space was ideal for two people and definitely worth the money (actually quite cheap considering the location). I’m not sure why some people complained about the restaurant next door—it was a huge plus for us! We grabbed coffee right away every morning, and it was never as loud as people said. I barely heard any noise at all.
The hosts were extremely responsive, kind, and helpful. We even locked the key inside once, and they came to open the door within 10 minutes. Overall, it was an excellent stay and I’d absolutely book here again.

The apartment is located on the ground floor directly in front of a restaurant, with the front door and windows facing the restaurant’s terrace. It’s just two steps from the front door to the restaurant's terrace, which is something I wish I had known before booking.
The noise from the restaurant is constant, lasting until after midnight. It felt like being inside the restaurant. Opening the windows wasn’t an option because the restaurant staff use the area outside the apartment as their smoking spot.
The curtains barely block any lights coming from the restaurant at night which makes it difficult to sleep.
While the apartment is tiny (although the photos show it larger than it is), the bigger issue was the unpleasant smell of humidity and mold. Despite the hosts offering extra cleaning, the smell persisted.
The apartment was clean, and the hosts clearly put effort into maintaining it. However, the proximity to the restaurant and the persistent smell made the stay less than ideal.

Very good value for money and well worth it over a longer stay, though some things to note, the kitchen was very sparsely furnished and very small (as per pictures) and the restaurant noise could take some getting used to, though really not to bad at all especially (during the week), contrary to some other reviews. Very well located!
Thanks very much!

Wonderful stay! The host was very responsive and helpful. Whenever we need anything, he was quick to respond and solve the problem. One night, we accidentally locked the bathroom door, and he even came late at night to help us open it. He also kindly allowed us an early checkin as we arrived early, and a late check-out because of the rain and our late flight.
The apartment is cute, clean, and in an amazing location around 8 m to Galata Tower, less than 5 m to tram station, there are lot of nice cafés and restaurants nearby.
He even arranged the airport transfer and it was also very convenient, with a punctual and respectful driver. (Much recommended)
I also saw reviews mentioning nighttime noise from the front restaurant , but we personally had no noise issues at all. ( we stayed 11 nights) not even one night we heard noise. Very calm.
Overall, we had a great experience and I would definitely recommend this place. I would happily stay here again on my next trip.

The apartment was beautiful and cozy. We were staying there for 4 nights and everything was great. The kitchen was well equipped, also there are many restaurants and cafes nearby too where you can go out for a dinner or breakfast. A pharmacy and a market where you can buy your groceries is around the corner. The metro station and Galata tower is in reach of five minutes. The one thing to consider when you stay at Merves apartment is the noise from the restaurant in front of the entrance. But we were out in the city anyway so it was not a problem for us. Thank you for the great communication! Till next time!

description:
We invite you to enjoy a stay in a spacious, clean apartment located in Istanbul's prime location.

Spacious 2 bedroom, 3 bathroom apartment with a large living room, lounge room, accommodating up to 8 guests.

The building located just a 10 minute walk from Taksim Square and 10 minute walk from Kabataş Coast, you'll be in the heart of Istanbul. Experience comfort and convenience in our centrally located home.

reviews.text: The apt is as described in the listing—very spacious. Check in was easy as Furkan met us and showed us around. Furkan was personable and communication was good. Location is excellent for exploring. Taksim Square is a 12 min walk, the M1 metro is a 10 minute walk (this will take you to tourist area of Sultanahmet). The ferry port of Cabatas is a 15 minute walk (Ferries to Kadikoy). To get to the metro and ferry you have to go down many stairs. To avoid having to go up the stairs when returning to the apt, just take the metro one stop further to Kabatas, from there take the funicular up the hill to Taksim Square and it is an easy 12 min walk back to the apt. 10/10 recommend.

We had an amazing time with our family! The house is even bigger than it looks in the pictures and incredibly comfortable. It had everything we needed and was spotlessly clean.
The location is perfect—right in the heart of Istanbul and very close to all the main tourist attractions.
Furkan is an outstanding host—super helpful, kind, and attentive.
Everything was perfect. Thank you so much for making our stay unforgettable!

Furkan was very friendly, helpful and easy to communicate with. The apartment was matching all the photos and descriptions. Located in a safe lockable building, clean, light and cozy. Supermarket and various cafes were just around the corner. We had a great experience. Thank you!

Wonderful stay. Large, clean and comfortable apartment with great light during the day. Amazing location on a quiet street while being close to the main bar / cafe are. Walking around the neighborhood a joy.
Furkan one of the most attentive hosts I’ve had the pleasure of meeting, he insisted on helping me check in personally at 1am even though self check in was possible, he responded to my questions and requests promptly and proactively made sure my stay was as easy and comfortable as possible.

We enjoyed our stay at this beautiful apartment. The apartment had all the facilities we were looking for, including three washrooms, a washing machine, elevator and air conditioning.
The neighbourhood was amazing and convenient. Within a few minutes of the T1 tram line, which we used regularly to get to Sultan Ahmet station, Eminonu etc. There is a nice cafe right next door, a grocery store beside the cafe and a big Jame masjid a few steps from the grocery store.
To avoid the stairs with our baby stroller on the way back up to the building from our outings, we either selected the “wheelchair accessible” filter in Google maps or used the Uber app to take a taxi back. For example, we paid 250TL for a taxi back from istiklal st late one night.
Furkan is a responsive helpful host who clearly takes pride in facilitating great stays. We hope to stay here again.

description:
Welcome to our accommodation located in Istanbul, in the historic district of Fatih. The building is classified as a second-degree historical building, and was built identically.
Located on the 1st floor, close to historic sites such as the Blue Mosque, the Grand Bazaar and Saint Sophia.
Enjoy complimentary tea and coffee in your room.
Just 400 meters from our accommodation, you will find a T1 tram stop, providing convenient access to the city's main sights and attractions.

reviews.text:
Firstly, Mustafa is one of the most responsive hosts you could ask for.
Any questions, issues, or any other thing in mind was 5 minutes away from a response.
About the place, the neighborhood in which it is located may at first seem look unsettling, but trust me, you will never feel any danger whatsoever. The place itself, looks exactly like the pictures, is in a convenient location and you can also make yourself some coffee or tea while planning out your day. There is no kitchen or stand, however. The room was cleaned maybe a bit lower to our expectations, but mind you, we arrived at 11am , and were inside the room by 1:30 pm, 2.5 hours earlier, not that it should be an excuse.
I am sure it was an isolated incident.
The comments about the building's isolation are correct, if there are people upstairs, you may have some trouble with the noise.
Overall, it was worth the price, especially the fact that you are no more than a 15 minutes walk away from any point of interest.
Thank u!

Great little apartment. Tucked away in a bit of a random location across from a busy shoe factory, but super nearby to all attractions which is great. Very clean and great shower pressure. The only things we noticed were that the WiFi was very patchy and the upstairs neighbours were quite loud (this bothered us more than the street noise, which we didn’t really mind at all!). Otherwise our stay was enjoyable and we had great communication about airport transfer and check in from the host.

We liked it very much to stay with Mustafa. Communication was easy and the room was exactly as described and very clean! The location was also quite easy to reach with public transport and close to a lot of points of interest. Overall we‘re happy and think, it’s a fair price for the location! :)

We had a lovely stay at this Airbnb. The apartment was just as beautiful as shown in the pictures, and the location was perfect. We were able to walk easily to popular tourist sites like the Grand Bazaar, the Blue Mosque, and Hagia Sophia, which made exploring the area a breeze. The bed was very comfortable, and it was nice to have the option of a heater during our stay.
Mustafa was incredibly helpful, offering to pick us up from the airport, and we appreciated the early check-in, which made our arrival much smoother.
However, there were a couple of downsides. The internet connection was poor, and it seemed like there was no way to fix it during our stay. We even had trouble opening Google Maps or accessing Google, as the connection would often drop.
Another issue was the noise level during the day, between 8am and 6pm. While I really appreciate the craftsmanship and hard work of the people around, the walls were quite thin, and the sounds of animals, people, and ongoing work could

It's a good place for its money with a great host!
It is a good flat with all the described amenities. You'll have everything you need for a short stay. The only fault we could find is the precise location. Don't get me wrong - it's great when it comes to sightseeing and public transport, all tourist attractions are a short walk away. However, the house is located near production houses, so you can see people making shoes at night through the window a couple of meters away, which is not bad, but rather surprising, and made us close the blinds all the time. The premises of the house are also pretty dirty with some trash lying around. I'm not saying it to complain - the stay was awesome, just wanted to point it out in case it's important for somebody out there.

description:
Exploring Istanbul couldn’t be easier!

Lovely apartment in the heart of the city. The location is great, very central and close to a supermarket, many restaurants, and bars.
Taksim square, bus and metro stations are just 2 minutes away on foot.
There are many foreigners and ex-pats in the neighborhood as well as locals.
There is a 24-hour paid parking right next to the building.

This is the center where it all happens yet you will feel very safe and comfortable in the area.

reviews.text:
The apartment was significantly smaller and more cramped than it appeared in the listing photos. Wide-angle photography made it look much larger, brighter, and more luxurious than it actually was, so the listing did not feel like an accurate representation of the property.
Cleanliness was also a serious issue. The bedsheet appeared dirty and had hair on it, and there was additional hair in the bathroom. The fridge was completely empty, with not even basic items or drinking water provided. When I raised my concerns, the host was rude and dismissive rather than helpful or apologetic.
Although the location was convenient, the misleading photographs, poor cleanliness, lack of basic hospitality, and the host’s attitude made this an unpleasant experience. I would not stay here again.

Love this apartment!!! I've stayed in this apartment 3 times over 3 years and ive loved every part of it. Its exactly as the pictures show, clean, comfortable, modern, practical, local... I can go on to describing all the positive aspects of it. Walkable distance to Taksim square and Istiklal Caddesi, but also far enough to get a good night's sleep away from the noise. Perfect location. Kadir is amazing to deal with, always very helpful. Allowed us to check in earlier than scheduled and check out later than advised. Wouldn't stay anywhere else.

Locations was amazing and central. Easy to get to İstiklal caddesi. And all the stores and restaurants - Walking up those hills you should be fine. A lıttle tiring but totally okay with that
The apartment was as per described and very clean and furniture was brand new. Bedroom was very comfy.
All amenities were as discribed.
Only suggestion I have is the hair drying can be an actual profression hair dryer at the ones providing really didn’t work on my hair.
We had a lot of luggage and the elevator was extremely handy as we were on the fourth floor.
All over I love this place and search for the apartment on my first search. Been 4 years ago and now refreshed some memories so thank you ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

My mom and I absolutely loved this air bnb! It was our first time in Istanbul, and this place was in the perfect spot. I would definitely recommend to anybody staying in Taksim. It is a little noisey from the city, but that’s expected being in the heart of the town. We were also super impressed with how clean the place was. The host was also very kind, and responded very quickly. 10/10 reccomend.

This was an exceptional place where the host had catered to every need, the place was very well kept and only a short walk to Taksim. Do keep in mind that there is a significant climb up the hill to reach Taksim square which is a very common scenario in Istanbul. I would highly recommend this place especially if you want to enjoy the amazing view from the balcony as well as have the warmth of a home inside.

description: Experience luxury in the heart of Istanbul at our stylish Sinpas Queen Bomonti apartment. Located in the vibrant Bomonti district, this modern space offers stunning Bosphorus views, a comfortable queen-size bed, a fully-equipped kitchen, and a sleek bathroom. Enjoy top-notch building amenities, including a fitness center, indoor pool, sauna, and rooftop terrace. With easy access to public transport and popular attractions, our apartment is perfect for business, families and leisure travelers.

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Şişli. The location is perfect close to everything you need, with easy access to transportation, shops, and great places to eat.
The apartment itself was very clean, cozy, and well maintained, making it feel like a true home away from home.
What really made the experience exceptional was the host, Shamsy. He was always available, incredibly helpful, and quick to respond to any questions or requests. His assistance made my stay even more comfortable.
I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. I’m already looking forward to staying here again on my next visit!

I enjoyed my stay very much! Nice area full of shops, cafes and restaurants and the street of the apartment is nice and quiet. The flat was very clean and well-decorated. I think it was better than it looks like in the photos. I would definetly recommend it!

The unit given was different from the one in the photos.
Dirty unit.

The apartment unfortunately did not meet expectations. There was a very strong and unpleasant smell inside the unit, and the cleanliness was not at an acceptable level. Additionally, the host mentioned that they would bring the access card for the swimming pool and sauna, but this was forgotten and never delivered during my stay. Overall, the experience was disappointing and I hope these issues will be addressed for future guests

We had a wonderful time staying here! As a family of three, the space worked perfectly for us. A huge bonus was the included parking, which made our trip so much easier.
We absolutely loved the incredible views from Level 44 they were a genuine highlight to the entire city . The host Anas was always quick to respond and super helpful.
Highly recommend!

description:
Our room is luxurious, modern and carefully designed. Located in our hotel, this room has a large double bed, a 32-inch smart television and a private bathroom. Our room a mini fridge and small kitchen supplies.
Our room is on the 2nd floor. There is a 24/7 camera and security system. The exterior door of the building is specially coded and protected. Our room is designed to accommodate 2 people.

reviews.text: The house was in really demanding place. Even it is bit small, the room has everthing and fell in love with the balcony which is a greatest part. Only problem is to find a parking area if you have a car. There is a parking lot right in the street (near Happy Center market), which is 1-2 minutes distance. I believe it is affordable(450TRY/night) for 2-3 days accommodation. Also there is a ISPARK close to Cıragan Palace, which is much cheaper(190TRY/night). If you go late at night, there is a high possibility to find an available lot. Anyway, everthing was super clean in the room, beds were comfortable and there are shampoo/body gel in bath. Also thanks for the free coffee. Host was responsive and helped all the questions that we have. If we will come Istanbul, we will definetely consider to stay here again.

Only have good things to say about the apartment. It was spotless clean, the bed was comfortable not too soft not too hard, very good AC and of course the cute balcony to chill after a long day.
2 big and 2 small towels and slippers were provided along with a few other necessities. Its also equipped with a good strong hair dryer. The neighborhood of Ortaköy has a lot of nice little cafes and traditional eateries as well as the more touristic waterfront area. We liked it a lot, but visitors should know that the only public transport to other parts of istanbul is buses and, not as frequently, boats, so travel needs to be planned accordingly.
We arrived almost an hour later than estimated due to the insane traffic and Hayat was patiently waiting, thanks again! All in all had a great stay, would definitely book again :)

Öncelikle konaklamamızdan memnun kaldığımızı belirtmek isterim. İletişim ve ulaşımda herhangi bir aksaklık yaşamadık. Olanaklar belirtildiği gibiydi, herşey temiz ve düzenliydi. Sadece "bizim için bir sorun oluşturmamakla birlikte" odanın fotoğraflardan daha küçük geldiğini belirtebilirim.
Bununla birlikte, konum olarak oldukça avantajlı. Bu bölgeden İstanbul'un herhangi bir bölgesine ulaşmak hem kolay hem de keyifli.
Mahalle içerisinde, geleneksel yapıyı ve kültürü deneyimleyebilirsiniz. Mahallenin bir parçası olarak uygun fiyatlı birçok mahalle fırını mevcut ve oldukça lezzetli ürünleri var. Aile sağlığı merkezi size 1 dk uzaklıkta, eczaneler, mahallenin taksi durakları vs. hepsi birçok ihtiyacınızı karşılayacaktır. Bu açılardan da kendinizi evinizde hissedebilirsiniz.

Good location. Ortakoy is safe and authentic, without crowds of tourists. You can definitely feel the life of locals here.
Comfortable, clean and modern apartments with everything you need. The balcony is the treasure of these apartments. This is the place you can relax after a long day and listen to the sounds of this huge city from your small island of calm.
And of course Hayat! He is the heart of these apartments. He always helps you with anything you need. Thank you so much

It was possibly the best Airbnb I have ever stayed at! From check-in to check-out, everything was perfect. The room matched the pictures exactly, everything was spotlessly clean, and the large balcony was a fantastic bonus. Everything about the stay was amazing. Thank you, Evra Suites!

description: New Apartment Residence with new fully furnished in the centre. Boheme style designed from our interior designers. You will feel warm and home. 5 min walking distance to metro and 3 shopping centre.

reviews.text: Exactly as described, really comfortable and tidy apartment host was responsibe and helpful really pleasant stay!!’

oved this place! The location is perfect – close to everything I needed, yet tucked away in a quiet neighborhood. The building itself is brand new and feels incredibly safe, which was a huge plus for me as a solo traveler. The apartment was clean, modern, and had everything I needed. I felt so comfortable and at home here. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a safe and convenient place to stay in Istanbul!"

İlan fotoğraflarındaki daireyle bize gösterilen yer aynı değildi. Ev sahibi sonrasında başka bir eve yönlendirdi, ancak orası da çok içime sinmedi. Yatak ve koltuklar biraz eskiydi, bu yüzden beklediğim konforu bulamadım. Belki bir yanlış anlaşılma olmuştur ama yine de ilanla gerçekte sunulan yerin daha net belirtilmesini isterdim.
Harika bir konaklamaydı, fotoğrafta olduğu gibi her şey yeni ve tertemizdi. İlgili bir ev sahibi tekrar konaklayacağım bir adres oldu.
Clean, spacious, friendly host. It is not self check-in tho.

description:
Welcome to our spacious, family friendly hideaway nestled in the vibrant heart of Istanbul! This beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment blends Turkish charm with modern comforts, offering a unique and serene retreat just steps away from Istanbul’s most bustling attractions. It is also located steps away from metro and bus stations.

The area is one of the most historic residential areas of Istanbul. You can find many cozy cafes, shops and local boutiques.

reviews.text: Great location and easy accessibility. The lift is finicky and kitchen pots and pans need to be changed. Overall the condo was clean and instructions provided by the host were accurate. The host is responsive and accommodating with our late checkout request.

This was our second time staying at this exact place, the place is as stated in the description. The check-in instructions were clear and easy follow. The apartment is spacious and clean.
The apartment manager Onur was responsive when one of the bed frames was having issues, he came over and fixed it the next day.
The only con is that we had no water in the apartment for over 10 hours, and could not get a hold of anyone until the next day to help us fix the issue.
Also, the walls are very thin in the apartment, any kind of noise / voice travels easy, even from upstairs.
Overall, it was a good stay and we would recommend it to others.

Everything worked flawlessly with Cordo‘s listing . The apartment was very comfortable for our large group of 7. The apartment was located in a neighborhood where everything was easily accessible like restaurants, groceries, dessert shop , public transport. Tramstation was 7 min by walk and metro station was 3 minutes by walk . The bus to the Istanbul airport can be taken also close to the metro station. The hosts also catered to our additional requests . All in all we had a comfortable stay. :)

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had a fantastic stay at this property! The host was absolutely amazing — very warm, responsive, and always ready to help with anything I needed. Check-in was smooth with the lockbox, and the house rules were clear and easy to follow.
The location is excellent. It’s only about 5–10 minutes to both the tram and metro stations, which made getting around the city incredibly convenient. The neighbourhood itself is wonderful — safe, vibrant, and full of great food options, cafés, and supermarkets. Everything I needed was just a short walk away.
The space was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making it feel like a true home away from home. Overall, I had a great experience and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. Would definitely stay here again!

Overall, it was a good experience, and communication with the host went smoothly. The apartment is conveniently located for someone traveling by car, as it’s close to the city center but avoids the ultra-central area where the worst traffic jams are. There’s a well-maintained underground parking facility nearby. The apartment is well-equipped with everything you need.
Some downsides:
1. The bed in the first bedroom creaks when you move on it.
2. Since the apartment is new and recently renovated, there are still a few traces left from the renovation work.
3. The sound insulation is not very effective, so if you have noisy neighbors, you will hear them quite clearly.

description: This 2+1 apartment in the center of Şişli offers comfort with its living room, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and equipped kitchen. The kitchen has all the necessary tools for cooking and eating. Bedrooms have sheets and bed linens. It is suitable and convenient for families. The apartment has a TV, fridge, stove and washing machine. The building has an elevator and the apartment has a private balcony.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The location was perfect with great access to the city.
The building was very convenient, especially with the elevator making it easy for residents to move around.
The apartment had a nice bathroom with excellent hot water 👌🏼 and everything was very comfortable.
The price was also very reasonable.
Enes was such a kind and responsive host, always quick to help and made sure everything was taken care of perfectly. Highly recommended!

I had a great stay at Koray’s place! The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures — cozy, clean, and very comfortable. The interiors were tastefully done, and the living space was bright and welcoming.
The location was excellent, right in the center of Şişli, making it very easy to get around. Check-in and check-out were simple and smooth. Koray was a wonderful host — very responsive and helpful whenever needed.
Overall, it was a comfortable and pleasant stay.

I had a wonderful 5-day stay at Koray’s place in Sisli, The apartment was beautiful and very clean. The neighborhood is also lovely, with plenty of restaurants and markets nearby, all within walking distance. Koray was a great host. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in Istanbul.

Great location.
The apartment is more or less worth the money. Fairly clean and well furnished.
We experienced some issues with ants in the kitchen, and the internet connection in the evenings (YouTube on the TV in the hall).

Ev sahibi Koray Beye ve bizimle ilgilenen Enes Beye çok teşekkür ederim. Evin konumu oldukça güzeldi ayrıca ev gerçekten çok geniş ve temizdi. Enes Bey otopark konusunda da bize yardımcı oldu. Kesinlikle İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimde konaklamayı düşüneceğim bir yer.

description: Experience the charm of Balat with breathtaking views of the Golden Horn from this cozy, stylish flat. Perfectly situated in one of Istanbul’s most historic and vibrant neighborhoods, this apartment offers a blend of comfort and local character. Enjoy watching the sunset over the water from your window, stroll through colorful streets, and explore nearby cafes, artisan shops, and iconic landmarks. Ideal for travelers looking to immerse themselves in the true spirit of Istanbul.

reviews.text: The apartment looked exactly like the photos, but it didn’t really feel cozy. The stay was fine overall, however I have stayed in much better places for a more reasonable price, so I do feel the apartment was a bit overpriced for what it offers. That said, it is well located and close to public transportation, but it’s worth noting that there aren’t many things to do in the area. Most importantly, the host was very helpful and responsive whenever I needed assistance.

ev sahibine çok teşekkür ediyorum bize çok yardımcı oldu. Eve giriş ve çıkış saatlerimiz konusunda esnek davrandı ve bizi kırmadı. Ev Fotoğraflardaki gibiydi temiz ferah. Konum olarak güzel bir yerdeydi ulaşım rahatlığı vardı. Eminim tekrar ziyaret edeceğim

We stayed a week in Oct 25.
Good bits
Location is good to get arround on foot or by public transport.
We found ourselves walking everywhere. Main bazaars towards the grand mosques and local centre Balat 20min.
The apartment has a small kitchen incl sink, refigerator, 2 ring electric standalone worktop cooker, a kettle, plates , glasses and utensils.
Bathroom with gas heated shower, one bedroom, kingsize bed, single wardrobe, mirror, one side table. Living room and a nice terrace with view of the river. AC worked great.
The bad bits
The apartment is the first floor and access is via steep, narrow and slippey when wet marble type external steps. Wasn't shown on any pictures for booking but formed part of the owners location plan. I add to bearhug large suitcases in the wet. Would not have booked if I knew about access arrangements.
Needs renovating.
Ants in the kitchen.
Bed uncomfortable and noisey. New pillows and duvet.
Iron leaks.
Washing face with cabinet over narrow sink.

Amazing AirBnB in a beautiful neighborhood. Metro and bus stations are within 5 minutes distance. The outside area is very nice with all the grapes. Lots of cheap places to eat as well and in a perfect location to explore the city by foot, taxi or metro/bus. Only downside is the smell in the bathroom which welcomes you whenever you enter the airbnb/bathroom. But at some point you stop noticing it. Overall an amazing AirBnB which is definitely worth your time in Istanbul.

Perfect apartment for those who value autonomy and is conveniently located right in front of Fener tramway station which allows you to easily get around the city via metro. The apartment was perfect, the bed comfortable and the view from the terrace was nice. Furkan and his friend were also helpful and accommodating. I would recommend coming for anyone looking to have a small apartment during their stay.

description: With a perfect location we will host you in a room with balcony in a silent street one minute to istiklal street and other turistic destinations .there are restaurants cafes bar market etc in a walking distance and we are here to help you whenever you need .

reviews.text:
perfect location good price
good balcony

Les différents hôtes étaient très serviables, le petit-déjeuner était bon et c’est un des meilleurs quartiers d’Istanbul, très chaleureux.
Le seul bémol a été lors de la première nuit, il y a eu un problème d’organisation et nous nous sommes retrouvés dans la mauvaise chambre, chambre visiblement pas préparée et assez poussiéreuse qui ne correspondait pas aux photos car ce n’était pas la bonne chambre.
Mais cette erreur a immédiatement été corrigé à notre réveil, et tout a été parfait dès ce moment-là.
Es ist sehr zentral, Personal sehr freundlich nur das Zimmer ist Renovierungsbedürftig zumindest was mein Zimmer betrifft !

Enver Beye ve çalışanlarına güler yüzlülüğü ve misafirperverliği için teşekkür ederim. Konumu ve odaları oldukça güzel. Otelin karşısında bulunan polis merkezi sayesinde oldukça güvende hissettik.Arkadaşımla çok memnun kaldık. İstanbula gelince kalacağımız tek yer.
Güzel bir yerdi , duş kabininin son sürgü yeri yoktu tamamen kapanmadığı için yerler ıslandı peçete koyulmamıştı ama hemen hallettiler bunlar dışında bir sorun yoktu teşekkürler

description: The apartment building has a special location in the city, close to trade and shopping centers (Trump Towers and Cevahir mall), banks, cinemas, theaters and art centers. You can easily reach E5, one of the main transportation routes in Istanbul, metro and metrobus. Our facility has a washing machine, kitchen, microwave, oven, air conditioning, smart TV and refrigerator. Among the amenities offered are free Wi-Fi access and free parking.

reviews.text: Evin en iyi tarafı konumu, ben o yüzden tuttum zaten. Metrobüse 3 dk, metroya da aynı şekilde. Civar yerlere yürüyedebilirsiniz. reviews.text:

If you’re looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Istanbul, we highly recommend it! We were very satisfied and would love to return.

Fatih was a great host. The apartment was just as pictured, very clean, and comfortable. The location was excellent, with lots of places to visit and things to do within walking distance. Fatih was responsive and easy to communicate with throughout my stay. I really enjoyed my trip and would be happy to stay here again.

All in all, if I go to Istanbul again I will definitely book this place, and I recommend it to others :)

Great stay in a fantastic location! The apartment was clean, spacious, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Many attractions, restaurants, and the Bosphorus are within walking distance. Fatih was very helpful and gave us great recommendations, and the receptionist was also very friendly. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend it.

I had an amazing experience at this Airbnb. The cleanliness was outstanding—everything was spotless, fresh, and well-maintained. The host clearly puts a lot of effort into keeping the space in top condition.

reviews.text: The accommodations were as described. The location was perfect for hanging out near Galata Tower and Taksim square or taking public transportation to the other attractions of the city. Besher is a great host and the apartment was nice as well. Not anything too fancy but matched then photos/descriptions and was well worth what we paid for it. Location was very ideal and walkable, close to public transport as well. Would definitely stay again.

We messaged Besher and he immediately arranged a cleaning lady to fix up the apartment for us and the issue was resolved in a few hours. Despite not being an ideal situation to arrive to, we really appreciated Besher's responsiveness and quickness in fixing the issue.

Besher was a great host throughout my stay in Istanbul. Very friendly, responsive, and helpful with clear communication from check-in to check-out. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient and made it easy to explore the city. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend staying here

(no not from us)
Besher was friendly and helpful, but I think this place would be best for one night stay and no more.

it was small comfy place. Besher was easy to communicate. There weren't any problems. I'm glad to stay there. Just reminder everything described as it is. No kitchen, good location, clean, safe place...

reviews.text: The place was clean, cozy, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. The apartment had 5 spacious bedrooms, was aesthetically very well done, and had everything you might need for a comfortable stay. Gulsen was extremely flexible and responsive throughout our trip, which made the experience even smoother.

description: Welcome to your perfect home away from home in Istanbul. This fully renovated, three story detached house offers the ideal blend of comfort, privacy, and authentic local charm.

reviews.text:
Stayed 7 nights in a spacious two-level villa/apartment. Good layout: 1 large bedroom with en-suite, 2 smaller bedrooms, plus a large rooftop room with a big balcony. 3 bathrooms (1 traditional-style, 2 with showers). Heating was excellent, kitchen well equipped with almost everything needed, and beds/mattresses were comfortable.
Main issues: unpleasant odor in all bathrooms, and linens/towels didn’t feel clean/fresh. TV had no local/international channels, and streaming apps had no active subscriptions, so entertainment was limited.
Location is a very local/non-touristy area: big plus for normal local prices (not inflated tourist pricing), and it felt very safe. About 10–13 min walk to Cibali tram. Many essentials nearby (supermarkets, local food, bakery, fish shops, etc.).

We decided on the house because it had two bathrooms and looked spacious for the 6 of us, as well as the location as it was advertised to be in a neighbourhood with nightlife.
Getting there was no problem with the shuttle, public transport is a 10 to 20 minutes walk away, depending on which service you need.
The house was cold when we got there, we had to figure out where the heating had to be turned on and from the drains in the toilets and bathrooms you could smell the sewage, which was unpleasant but in the living areas not that noticeable.
The towels & bedsheets had some stains but where otherwise clean.
Overall it was alright for the price, but needs some maintenance done.
Unfortunately we never met Mert in person, but he’s been super fast to respond in the chat and very helpful.

The house looks exactly like in the pictures. It is very spacious and beautiful, and a great option for a group. The rooms are big, bright and comfortable, the beds are large and very comfy, and the terrace is really lovely.
However, there were several issues. The bathrooms smells very bad, so we had to use incense every day to tolerate it. The bathroom fans are extremely loud, so using the toilet at night wakes up the whole house. The downstairs toilet was especially problematic, as the smell affected the entire lower floor. The street is very noisy, which made sleeping difficult.
Although the house looks beautiful and matches the photos, the overall quality and maintenance did not meet the same standard.
We did not meet the host, but Turkar was extremely helpful and responsive, arranging laundry service, fixing the dishwasher, and even refunding one night, which we appreciated.
Overall, the house has a lot of potential, but it needs improvements in cleanliness, and maintenance.

The host was very responsive; I am really thankful for him.
However the house was well below standard. The main sofa was broken, nearly all furniture and rugs were badly stained and needed deep cleaning/replacement. The house, esp. the bathrooms smelled like sewer with loud and ineffective fans. Kitchen was dirty, with several chipped plates. No internet in the house for almost 24hrs upon our arrival; no toilet paper and hand soap in the bathrooms (we had to request) the one bathroom that had a bidet, had a malfunctioning hose that constantly fell off and sprayed water everywhere. One of the showers had a broken shower head which we had to request service for. Same with the water heater, died one day during our trip. I would say the courtyard was the only beautiful and functioning part of this place.
The house itself is on a relatively busy street and across from a late night game cafe in which people played and spoke loudly till 1-2 AM.
I would not recommend this place to anyone.

We stayed at Mert Villa for 7 days. This was my sixth time visiting Istanbul, and I’ve always chosen an Airbnb property for my stays. This detached house was fantastic, featuring four bedrooms with double beds and two kitchens. The garden and terrace were beautiful. The host was very friendly and promptly resolved any issues we had.
The area was vibrant, with plenty of local supermarkets and cafes, and it’s just a 20-minute walk to the Grand Bazaar. All the windows and doors had padlocks, making us feel very secure. Overall, my family and I were thoroughly satisfied with our stay in this house.

reviews.text: This apartment is located in a great neighborhood in Istanbul, close to everything you need, and has two bedrooms that comfortably accommodate four people. Overall, the apartment is in good condition, except for a few issues with the closet, the toilet, and one of the fans, which are in poor condition. Ahmet was attentive and helpful throughout our entire stay. Thank you very much.

The location was great but when we got there there was nothing like tea or coffee. But after some time we run into woman who gave us what we needed. But after all the host was very kind and helpful. I recommend this place because of two bedrooms and privacy. It was very quiet street near by the centre. The standard of the place was okey

Thank you Ahmet for hosting us!
This was a great place for a short stay!
No street parking around but there are few paid parking places nearby.
Nice place for 4 max 5 people.
The apartment is very nice and cozy, the location is extremely good and Ahmet was a great host!

I highly recommend this place. Ahmet, the host, was very attentive and responsible, and he handled any issue immediately. I would definitely recommend staying here. The place was very clean, quiet, and had all the amenities we needed.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Wonderful hosts! I spent about two weeks in Istanbul staying at their apartment.
First of all, the location is perfect. It’s just a three-minute walk to the Bosphorus, and the windows face a fairly quiet street, so you’re guaranteed a peaceful night's sleep. At the same time, the parallel street is bustling with life, tourists, and plenty of great spots.
The building is historic, featuring a stunning spiral staircase and high ceilings inside. The apartment itself had everything I needed: clean bed linen, a set of towels, a fan, a kettle with a tea set, a small clothes rack, and a shower with good water pressure. The hosts were very quick to respond and always accommodating to my needs. I felt safe the entire time.
Anyway, thank you so much! I’d love to visit you again!!

Lots of restaurants around, beautiful neighborhood. The host was so responsive and the room was as described. It's just a bit cold during the wintertime as there is not very good functional heating but good for the price. Recommended!

The area is nice and very close to the bus station. The host is also very responsive. I slept well but at first it was a bit difficult. The room is directly next to the street so you can hear everything outside. I recommend earplugs. The room heater is controlled by the central unit so it was cold at first and then got extremely hot when they turned it up; you cannot control the heat yourself. The shower also doesn’t drain well and the bathroom sink leaks water onto the floor. The window was also broken and open when I arrived; I fixed it myself. The price is relatively good but these issues should be fixed. Despite those things, the room was fine and served its purpose.

First of all Özlen is a professional host , she replies so fast and she’s there when needed , the place was warm and cozy it was clean , everything in place , good wifi , good bathroom , fantastic neighborhood ,
I totally recommending it .

I'm starting to say my thought about the House. First, the place of the House was really bad at the entrance floor and you look very clear from the glass as it was adjacent to a very busiest Street. Privacy is almost no way. Secondly, after this situation bothered me so much, I shared this situation to the landlord and the host never helped me in any way, even if it would go dissatisfied I started talking more rough. I did even offer much money to change my room because the host never helped in any way despite him, certainly made moves without thinking of my satisfaction. No day cleaning was done, although I stayed for four days in third. and fourth I wanted ashgness from the landlord 4 times but he ignored it .He had a very careless and rude attitude. The good side of the House , the beautiful satisfies you for location but you can't see any of the sea paintings in the proclamation was completely misleading.I'm not suggesting this House and the landlord to anyone, unfortunately.

description: Take a break and unwind at this peaceful oasis.

reviews.text:
The location is fairly quiet, peaceful and safe. However, there is a steep slope, so you have to walk uphill to reach the main street.
Musa is a friendly and responsive host. The check-in was great.
During my stay, the electricity went out at night, so there was no light. And for some reason there was no hot water in the shower. But everything came back on after a couple of hours.
The photos match reality. There is also an air conditioner, which is very handy in summer.
Overall, great value for money

Musa is a very good host. He proactively provided various assistance and helped us keep our lost bag. The room was clean and tidy, there was no noise around, and it was a very cost-effective room. The location is very close to Taksim Square, which is very suitable for strolling around. I highly recommend staying in Musa's room in Istanbul

I had a wonderful stay at this place. Musa is an exceptional host, always ready to help and provide guidance with everything I needed. The room was clean and very comfortable. The location was convenient, allowing me to walk to various attractions easily.
I especially appreciated the peaceful atmosphere, as it was important for me to have a quiet environment. I couldn't hear any street noise or disruptive neighbors. Overall, I highly recommend this place!

For the price you can not go wrong.
Aircon needs tweaking so it gets colder.
And new linens are needed but the price for the location was great.
Musa is nice and responsive

Musa is a good attentive person trying to run an honest business. The attic rooms are quieter for those who are sound conscious. We were first put in Rm6 which is definitely better for 2 persons. More light, more space. Rm7 has a huge bed but the space is too small for 2 persons with a tiny bathroom unless it’s a very short stay. The showers worked well. Musa was helpful with every request he could comply with. The place is very close to Taksim Sq and Istiklal caddesi which is the main pedestrian road in Istanbul where the old tram runs. It’s good value.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming accommodation. Our hotel is Istanbul's most popular Galataport, Galatakulesi, Eminönü. It is within walking distance on Istiklal Street. It is 1 minute walking distance to the tram line and you can easily reach anywhere you want.

reviews.text:
I stayed for two nights at Galata WAW Hotel in Istanbul and overall had a very pleasant experience.
The location is definitely one of the biggest advantages — it’s right in the heart of the Galata area, within walking distance to major attractions, restaurants, and public transport. Perfect if you want to explore the city on foot.
The room was clean and comfortable, with everything needed for a short stay.
The staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay, always available if needed and willing to assist with recommendations or questions.
If I had to mention a small downside, it would be that the the air conditioning unit was quite loud at times .
Overall, I would recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a convenient, clean, and well-located place to stay in Istanbul, especially for short visits.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great stay at Waw Hotel! The rooms were clean and comfortable, the staff was friendly and helpful, and the location was perfect for exploring Istanbul. I would definitely stay here again!

Excellent location! Close to the water and surrounded by nice restaurants. Room was spacious and had extra bedding. Lighting could be better, especially because it was always cloudy so even natural light wasn’t much help. The shower is amazing - immediate hot water with good pressure. I didn’t pack an umbrella, but the host had lots to loan right by the door. Overall, excellent place. Highly recommend!

All hosts were very friendly and kind and made us feel welcome! The room was very nice and overall clean, some parts of the bathroom were a bit rusty but other than that everything was okay. We had a problem with the light and the host was super responsive they fixed it very quickly. The area where the hotel is located is ideal! We had a great stay, thank you very much!

Overall: 8.5/10
The stay was great, the location is great, close to Taksim and Galata Tower, close to bus stops and walkable to from lots of places. The receptionists were great, very friendly and really helpful, always trying to support with anything we needed.
Cons: the AC was loud and while off during the night it was starting to do loud noises not clear from where these were coming from

description: Located in the heart of Gümüşsuyu, just a 10-minute walk from Taksim Square and Kabataş, this stylish 1BR apartment offers the perfect base for exploring Istanbul. The apartment features a spacious living room, a bright and cozy bedroom, a fully equipped kitchen, and a modern bathroom. You’ll be within easy reach of public transport, cafés, restaurants, and the Bosphorus waterfront. An ideal choice for guests seeking comfort, convenience, and a well-designed home in a central location.

reviews.text:
A little bit of a disappointing stay. The flat has been recently remodelled but it's perhaps not quite at the standard as the photos make out. The floorboards in the bedroom squeak and when moving in certain parts of the bed, you can hear loud creaks. The large boiler shown in the photo has been replaced with a small electric unit which is almost hanging in the shower. Whilst in good condition, all of the furniture is very old. The bathroom has little ventilation and can develop an unpleasant smell. Cars can be audible outside on the passing road from the bedroom.
But there are positives. Communication with Hanemo was excellent at all times with swift responses. Location is superb, very close to Taksim. The building is super warm during winter. The internet is some of the best I had in Turkey. The exposed brickwork looks good and there is plenty of space.
The flat has a lot of potential, but for the listed price, a lot of the fittings need further modernisation.

We enjoyed our stay at this accommodation! It was very comfortable and has everything you will need for a long stay. The location is wonderful! Close to a metro station only about 5-10 min walk to the main station in Taksim. Additionally we loved having the little corner store downstairs we could grab any necessities that we were missing quickly. On that note, there is a grocery store very close by about 5 to 7 minute walk which has all of the stuff you will possibly need. Definitely recommend!

This is an amazing apartment! So happy that had chosen it. From the first minute you feel like at home. Located in great place, very close to supermarkets, one of the shop is right in front of the building, not far from Taksim square. There is everything you need in the apartment, no need to think what else you need to purchase to live there. Everything is thought out to the smallest detail. The host is very responsive, was always connected, requested if we need something or have any questions. Will definitely come again. This is the best choice we did to stay in Istanbul. Thank you very much for the great stay

The house is average. Heating is always on as the handle is broken. It gets no sunlight. The only windows available are on the main street and if you try to open them, there will be weird dudes looking. I think the shop in front is paid by Hanemo to keep an eye on the apartment understandably but they do it excessively. Yet, the biggest problem is the admin working with Hanemo, they are hungry and they want to make profit outside Airbnb. I asked them to lock the calendar for the rest of the month because I had problem with online payment and I can pay in a few days the rest of the stay, they refused initially because they had no guarantees, so I agreed to give them a deposit to lock the calendar until I fix my online payment issue. Since they received deposit they have tried all sort of things to get me to pay all the rest in cash or bank transfer outside Airbnb, which I refused. They only gave me my deposit back when I said I will call tourism authorities. They are not trustworthy
Nice place with great location

description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this place in a perfect location.

I definitely recommend this place, if you want to visit lots of places in Ortaköy, Beşiktaş. Price is affordable for this suitable location. It is next to the cost with wonderful bridge scene. Small, but really clean.

description: Step into a thoughtfully designed home where comfort meets style. This modern apartment features a seamless blend of rustic textures and contemporary finishes, ideal for short stays or extended visits in Istanbul. 1-minute walk to Taksim Square

reviews.text: The apartment is in a great location. The area can be a bit noisy, even at night, but that’s to be expected in the center of Istanbul. All major landmarks are easily accessible from here. We had a small issue unlocking the apartment, but the hosts answered our call within a minute and were very responsive. On the first day we noticed a gas smell, and the owner immediately sent a technician to fix it. The apartment is comfortable for 3–4 people. Since we didn’t spend much time inside, it offered a good balance of price and quality. Keep in mind that buildings in this part of the city are older, so you shouldn’t expect brand-new construction or modern finishes.

Absolutely perfect apartment for a city break. The location is right on Taksim Square, walking distance to all the busy life of Istanbul with lots of restaurants, street food, shops, coffee shops etc. 1 min walk to public transport that gets you anywhere in the city.
The apartment is very safe, clean and warm and has everything you need. Couldn’t have asked for more. The host communicated with us very well and made sure we were satisfied with everything.
I would definitely recommend booking airport transfer through the host as well which avoids all the hassle of over priced local taxi’s and saves time.

We enjoyed our stay very much
The place as described with all facilities but We recommend to add microwave to the facilities as it is quick to use more than the oven to warm the meals and milk
The staff very friendly and quick responsive with any problem
Best location near every thing and transportation minutes to Istiklal street
Many thanks for indigo property staff
Spacious and clean apartment, very central location , a bit noisy neighbourhood. Good communication with the owner.

We enjoyed our stay very much. Comfortable and well equipped. Enjoyed the extra little room for luggage.
The apartment is located really close to the mosque, which was wonderful. Also very central for Taksim and to get to Galata Tower.

description: Located in the heart of Kadıköy, this modern 1+0 mansion offers a comfortable accommodation experience. Close to downtown, in an advantageous location in terms of transportation. Its stylish interior has a comfortable bed and a clean bathroom. The kitchen is shared with other guests, but it is fully equipped and clean. A pleasant atmosphere is provided with city views and large windows that receive natural light. Restaurants, cafes and shopping spots are within walking distance. Ideal for a comfortable and cozy stay!

reviews.text:
Worst stay. We were forced out mid-stay by an aggressive host, ruining our Istanbul vacation.
Note: Most reviews are from locals and a single account (9). Few foreign reviews.
Super loud: Every step from upstairs is audible. We endured a sex marathon midnight–3am with objects banging on the floor (other reviews mention this too). We had no sleep.
Safety/quality: Smoke detectors were taped off. We smelled marijuana from a neighbor. Furniture is falling apart: broken toilet lid, holes in windows letting mosquitos in, door handles dropping off, unstable fridge placement.
Aggressive host: Slow to respond pre-check-in. Once we raised complaints, bombarded us with calls mid-sightseeing threatening with police and removing our belongings. We contacted Airbnb and police to safely retrieve our things and check out.
The kitchen is decent and the repairman was kind.
This place suits party-goers, not tourists! The carpet smelled of urine. If you're visiting Istanbul to sightsee, look elsewhere.

The place was clean. Room was great size but the toilet was tiny. There is no noise reduction/insulation of the rooms. Intimate noise from room upstairs was disturbing. It was like an audio of a x rated movie. Communication was ok although I have still not heard since I messaged the land lady that I m checking out and have left the keys as instructed. I will not stay in this apartment again.
Everything was great. Thanks to the great host. Nice and clean location

description:
A stylish, fun and cozy flat in the heart of Cihangir — one of Istanbul’s most creative and bohemian neighborhoods. Step outside and you’re just a minute away from cute cafés and local restaurants. Only 5 minutes to Taksim Square, Istiklal Street and the metro; 8 minutes to the tram and the Bosphorus strait. The perfect spot to enjoy the city, wrapped in a colorful and inspiring design.

REMINDING THAT,
-Flat is located on the 3rd floor of the building with NO ELEVATOR!
-No NOISE [PHONE_LIKE_STRING REDACTED]

reviews.text: The apartment was amazing! It was exactly as the pictures. Me and my friends really appreciated the style, the location and overall our living experience. The host was very nice too, helped us with recommendations, especially for the place to leave the luggage before our flight. The only disadvantage was the circular stairs as we had very heavy luggage, but we were mentally prepared for this as it was mentioned in the description. The bathroom was nice and comfortable, especially compared to other options of apartments in Istanbul. It was also pleasant to wake up with the view of green trees. The location is near many grocery stores and great restaurants, it was a short walk to the transport stations (the metro station especially). Overall it was a great experience! We definitely recommend this apartment for your Istanbul trip!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Cihangir. The location was fantastic, with great cafés, restaurants, and local shops just a short walk away. It was also easy to reach Karaköy, Galata, and public transportation on foot.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was easy, and the host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay.
A great place to stay while exploring Istanbul - we would happily come back!

We really enjoyed this apartment - beautifully and comfortably furnished, cozy bedrooms, kitchen and bathroom are excellent, and we love the little balcony. Quick walk to the tram or metro, grocery stores nearby, and the street itself is picturesque. The hosts are friendly and helpful - they provided excellent instructions for the apartment and answered every question. Would recommend, especially for families that need a comfortable and convenient home away from home.

The apartment was identical to the photos! Really aesthetically pleasing place. We had no issues finding it. Unfortunately the house doesn’t have an elevator but that didn’t really affect our stay.
The neighbourhood around is quite quiet and safe. Note that you can hear a party somewhere down the road or far away that might affect your sleep if you are sensitive to it.
Not that far from Taksim square. Around 10 minute walk to the transport.
The apartment had all needed equipment for the comfortable stay there. Like kitchen equipment, detergent, cotton pads etc.
The owner was so easy going and explained everything.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It’s newly renovated, modern, and beautifully decorated in a pop-art style. Everything was thoughtfully prepared—there was even a sewing kit and big bottle of water waiting for us. Every room has air conditioning, and the kitchen was stocked with coffee, tea, sugar, detergent, and more.
The location is very convenient; we parked our car and used the nearby tram, bus, and ferry instead. The apartment was so cozy that we sometimes didn’t even want to go out!
Hosts provided excellent service, and they were always quick to respond. Truly better than the photos—highly recommended!

description: Enjoy a memorable stay in this bright and spacious 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Galata, accommodating up to 7 guests. One bedroom offers a stunning Galata Tower view and a partial Bosphorus view. With 4-meter-high ceilings, wide sunlit windows, two queen bedrooms, one twin room, a fully equipped kitchen, and 1.5 bathrooms, it’s ideal for families or friends. Surrounded by antique shops, vintage stores, and art galleries—just minutes from lively İstiklal Avenue.

reviews.text:
Incredible place, very beautiful and spacious apartment with everything you need for a comfortable stay of 10 days or more.
Great location: the metro is a 5-minute walk away, and it’s within walking distance to the waterfront, a big mall, the tram station, Galata Bridge, and the main shopping street.
The host was very proactive and always happy to provide helpful recommendations.
Although the neighborhood is quite touristy, the building itself is on a quiet street, so you won’t hear restaurant noise or crowds. Just be aware that being close to the Bosphorus, you may hear seagulls at night.

Beautiful apartment with wonderful balcony and great views.
The flat is bright, clean and comfortable.
Walkable to Galata tower and surrounding area - highly recommended!
Beautiful home in an awesome location. Minutes from all the action and right down the street from Galata Tower. Daria was very responsive and proactive with communication.
Beautiful place, incredible location, amazing communication from Oktay who couldn’t have been more helpful - couldn’t have been better.
Evin konumu muhteşem bir yerde evin içeriside fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibi gayet keyifli bir tatil yaptık tekrardan görüşmek üzere 😊

description:
Hello my dear next guest:)

This is a studio type flat but not small like classic studio types:)
All the flat is new... walls floors toilet kitchen and also furniture. Everything is same like you see in the photos.

Location is perfect .. just 4 minutes walking way to taksim square where you can find all public transportation... many shops, restaurants, markets, bars, coffee shops, hospital and much more will be next to you:)

if you have any question feel free to ask... i hope to see you:)

reviews.text:
The place was amazing, clean , same as the photos and the host was super friendly she was responsive.
The airbnb is near taksim square and close to everything.

The apartment was in an excellent location, just a 3 minute walk to Taksim Square, yet it was peaceful and quiet. The place was very clean, comfortable, and had all the essentials provided by the owner, so there was no need to bring too much with you. The owner was thoughtful and made sure everything needed for a comfortable stay was available. I highly recommend this apartment, especially for a maximum of two people. I would definitely stay here again.

The outside surrounds are a little ruff but the inside of the apartment was lovely and I appreciated that the host had put drinks and snacks in the fridge. My stay started well but the next day I had water leaking from the ceiling in the bathroom, I mopped it up and but a pot under it before letting the host know and heading out for the day ( no drama ) it was fixed but then a day later leaked again, the host got back to me and in truth it wasn’t that big a deal …. Things happened. But on the morning that I was to check out at 12 midday I was abruptly awoke at 5 am to the water pipe in the lounge bursting. Water was coming out at chest level and flooding the apartment quickly. I had not packed so in the dark as I didn’t want to touch the lights and electrocuted myself I got myself and my bags downstairs and onto the street dripping wet with water running down the stairs & rd also the exterior of the building. The host to his credit was there by 6am. I hope the problem is fixed.
Small apartment in good location not too far to walk to Taksim Square. Narrow stairs case to access the apartment on the 1st floor. Responsive host, easy access to the apartment Clear instructions.
It was clean, the location was perfect and we could get anywhere from there, the host was responsive and checking in and out was a breeze.

description: Our hotel, located in the center of Istanbul, is just a few steps away from the metro. You can easily reach historical and touristic places, shopping centers, and public transport links. We offer a pleasant stay with our comfortable rooms and friendly staff. We provide assistance with parking depending on availability. Breakfast is not included in the accommodation fee; you can purchase it at the reception for an additional fee if you wish.

reviews.text: A nice place to stay near Nişantaş , walkable to cafes, restaırants and shops, very clean,. friendly and helpful staff. Reccomendable)

konum olarak mükemmel her yere yakın nişantaşı’na yürüyerek geçebilirsiniz metroya yürüyerek sadece iki dakika bu konuda çok iyiydi tek rahatsız eden şey ses yalıtımı çok zayıf gelen ses rahatsız etti zaman zaman

description: Our Family Room is located just 300 meters from Galata Tower, in the heart of the historic peninsula, directly across from Galata Port and Karaköy. The apartment features a double bed, a sofa bed, a kitchenette, a private bathroom, and a small garden. Public transportation is only 1 minute away, and Istiklal Street (Taksim Square) is a 5-minute walk. The apartment is new, safe, and has been welcoming guests since January 1st, 2020. A local guide is available for nearby attractions.

reviews.text: Great apartment in a perfect central location in Istanbul! We booked right before our flight to rest, and the host was super responsive — check-in was fast, smooth, and very well organized. The stay was extremely comfortable and hassle-free. Thank you so much!
Evin enerjisi dizaynı özellikle ışıklandırması çeşitli ve çok keyifliydi. Ev sahibi ilgili ve cidden içimize sinecek derecede temizdi. Tesekkürler.
