description: A rare find in the heart of Galata — a beautifully designed duplex with its own private garden, blending Ottoman-inspired details with modern comfort. Two bedrooms, three bathrooms, a designer kitchen, and a lush green oasis just steps from Galata Tower and Istanbul's best cafes, restaurants, and nightlife..

reviews.text: Evin konumu, iç dizaynı ve kalabalık bir muhitte yer almasına rağmen oldukça sakin ve huzurlu olması harikaydı. Ev hem temiz hem ferahtı, bahçesi keyifliydi. Ev sahibi tüm soruları hemen cevapladı, giriş ve çıkış çok kolaydı. Umarım rezervasyonda boşluk bulup tekrar konaklayabiliriz :)

Apartment is exactly as described. Even though it’s just 7 mins walk to Galata the apartment is totally away from the noise and very private.
Backyard is beautiful and peaceful and looks exactly in the photos. Overall I highly recommend the place.

Arek is very responsive host and actively communicating with us. He also responded to some of requests for kitchen and arrange quickly. The back private garden is big asset considering how centre of the city where this place located.

Galata area is extremely congested but Arek’s
Home is a little haven in the madness outside. It has a lovely backyard which are frequented by 4 wonderful cats. Second bedroom doesn’t have the air conditioning but upon request, Arek immediately arranged for a fan. Which was a life saver. He also allowed us late checkout without extra cost.
One thing to note—the house does require a little more upkeep like the freezer door and the blinds that weren’t working in the main bedroom. We’d still recommend this place if you’re visiting Istanbul and want to stay close to the hustle bustle of the galata area.

Place was great, spacious and clean. the only issue we had is the light switches are weird arrangement and the outlet next to the master bed was broken. water pressure is great and laundry works great. would stay again

description:
Located in the heart of historic Istanbul, this officially registered, spacious apartment welcomes up to 10 guests-perfect for families and groups looking to experience the city.

Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Topkapı Palace, the Grand/Spice Bazaar, Basilica Cistern and Eminönü are all within a 10–15 minute reach.

Yusufpaşa tram stop is just steps away; Yenikapı metro hub is a 5-minute walk.

- Please note there is no elevator to the 4th floor.
- Rooftop BR has a low ceiling&accessed via a ladder.

reviews.text:
Mitat was a great host, he answered all queries and did so in a timely manner.
The apartment itself was exactly as described, clean, cool & spacious - the large screen projector and AC were great features.
The location of the apartment was excellent, there is a tram spot across the road that takes you to the Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque in under 10 minutes, there is a row of ATM machines directly outside and at the bottom of the building there is a cafe open until late.
Within a 10 minute walk from the apartment there are dozens of 24/7 restaurants, cafes and stores, with our personal favourite being Yusufpasa Baked Goods (we found this in the guide provided by Mitat in the apartment). At Yusufpasa baked goods the breakfast, food & dessert options were great and the staff were extremely friendly to the point we visited multiple times a day.
This was my 4th time in Istanbul and all things considered this was by far the best Airbnb/hotel I have stayed in.

Mitat and Feyza were lovely hosts from start to finish! The house was clean, comfortable and really homely, with everything we needed to feel right at home. They were always responsive and helpful whenever we needed anything.
The location was also great, with easy access to all the main transport options and everything you need nearby. We had a really lovely stay and would definitely recommend them and stay again!

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev oldukça temizdi ve fotoğraflardakiyle tamamen aynıydı. Özellikle arıtma su sistemi olması bizim için büyük konfor oldu, ekstra su taşımak zorunda kalmadık. Akşam terasta İtalya’dan getirdiğimiz proseccomuzu keyifle yudumladık; ortamın ambiyansı gerçekten çok keyifliydi.
Konum da çok avantajlıydı. Yusufpaşa tramvay durağına birkaç dakika içinde yürüyebildik, Kapalı Çarşı ve Ayasofya’ya ulaşmamız yaklaşık 10 dakika sürdü. Giriş süreci oldukça kolaydı ve Mitat iletişim konusunda hızlı ve yardımcıydı, kısa kalmamıza rağmen bir kaç kez nasıl olduğumuzu sordu. Kısa konaklamamız boyunca her şey çok konforluydu, tekrar tercih ederiz.
Good value for money. Great location close to public transport with plenty of restaurants nearby. Lovely space and view from deck/window. Everything we needed was provide in well-stocked kitchen

Accomodation was perfect for our family of 6. It was well maintained spotlessly clean and was a short tram ride to the Blue Mosque and other attractions in Istanbul. A washing machine and dryer were also a bonus whilst travelling as a large group. Mitat was an awesome host and arranged transfers for us to and from the Airport.

description: Located in Beyoğlu, one of Istanbul's most historic districts, this elegantly restored apartment promises a peaceful stay. Its location puts you very close to the city's most central areas. The building features a beautiful and spacious lobby area, a shared space where you can enjoy your time and socialize with other guests. You can also enjoy coffee and tea while staying in the building with our unlimited Wi-Fi service. Please note that we do not accept guests without reservations

reviews.text: Had a lovely stay at Berna’s apartment for 6 days. It was super clean, welcoming, had all the amenities and the hosts were very nice and responsive. Definitely worth the money!

Host was very welcoming and accommodating. Laundry was done by staff easily, and there was may facilities that made my stay feel at home. AC, great shower, steaming iron, dishes and kettle, and great comfy bed.
Very good price for the room, host was very helpful with times.
Super clean and nice hosting ✌🏼
Nice and clean :) jas good wifi and air condition

description: The apartment is on the -1st floor

reviews.text: we stayed 2 nights, overall it was really good experience. it is just like in the photos and the place was clean. the jakuzi was working and there was a fridge. the location is pretty active and safe, super close to the metro. the host responded pretty fast and he was really helpfull, we could leave our luggage before check in. the only downside i would say that the room is in downstairs, so the phone didnt have signal most of the times. there is wifi but it was pretty slow. and also, the room wasn't damp, but it felt a bit stuffy sometimes for the same reason. if u plan to stay on longer periods u may wanna consider about these. we didnt mind about it, it is really affordable room considering the rooms with jakuzis are usually much more expensive.

Odaya ilk girdiğimizde bizi oldukça kötü ve ağır bir koku karşıladı. Odanın genel temizliği ve bakımı maalesef beklentimizin oldukça altındaydı. Yatak örtülerinde belirgin şekilde sigara yanıkları vardı ve bu durum oldukça rahatsız ediciydi. Koltuk da aynı şekilde sigara yanıklarıyla doluydu ve üzerinde çok sayıda leke bulunuyordu. Bu nedenle odadaki eşyaların temizliği ve hijyeni konusunda kendimizi pek rahat hissedemedik.
Bunun yanı sıra Wi-Fi neredeyse hiç çekmiyordu ve kullanım açısından ciddi bir sorun yaşadık. İnternet bağlantısının odada bu kadar yetersiz olması özellikle konaklama süresince oldukça rahatsız ediciydi.
Olumlu olarak, tuvalet ve banyonun temiz olması dikkatimizden kaçmadı. Jakuzi de genel olarak temiz ve kullanışlıydı, bu konuda herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Ancak odanın genelindeki kötü koku, sigara yanıkları, lekeli mobilyalar ve Wi-Fi problemi nedeniyle konaklama deneyimimiz maalesef olumsuz oldu. Odanın yenilenmesi, tekstil ürünlerinin değiştirilmesi ve gene

Oldukça güzel bir konaklamaydı. Bize kalırsa tek problemi -1’de olduğu için telefonun çekmemesiydi ama bu durumu wifi ile çözüyorsunuz biz iletişimimizi bu şekilde sağladık ve bir problem yaşamadık. Onun haricinde kusursuzdu ve gayet temizdi. Yusuf Beyler oldukça yardımcı oldular. Bir daha gelecek olsak bir daha tercih ederiz.

Konum ve yer olarak çok iyi fakat giriş için bilgilendirme yapılmayıp biz adresten otelin adını bulup arayıp bilgi almak zorunda kaldık. İçeride yaşadığımız deneyim çok güzeldi sadece mini buzdolabı soğutmuyor ve duşakabinin kapısı olmadığı için yerler ister istemez ıslandı. Bu eksiklikler haricinde -1 olduğu için cam yok gün ışığı girmiyor içeri uzun süreli konaklamada sıkıntı oluşturabilir fakat biz bir gece konakladığımız için problem olmadı. İlk girdiğimizde ağır sigara kokusu karşıladı havalandırma açık olmasına rağmen. Kliması gayet iyi soğutuyor. Genel olarak memnun kaldık diyebiliriz. Jakuzinin mumları yoktu biz 2 tane ekledik bizden sonrakiler güle güle kullansın :)

gayet memnun kaldim. ilk basta -1. katta olmasi bir tik endiselendirmisti fakat hiçbir problem yasamadim havalandirmasi yeterliydi temizdi ve duzenliydi. jakuzi temizdi her sey olmasi gerektigi gibiydi cok memnun kaldim👍🏻

description:
Enjoy the comfort of the colorful Pumpkin Suit 🎃

Located at the crossroads of Ataşehir and Ümraniye, this apartment offers easy access to both the hospital district and the Financial Center. If you’re a "I love Istanbul but not its crowds" person, this is the perfect match for you ;)

reviews.text: Ev temizdi ve konforluydu. Fotoğraflar gerçeği ile aynıydı. Konumu rahattı. Hızlı iletişim kurduk. Kendimi evimde hissettim. Herkese tavsiye ederim

İş gezim sırasında bu evde konakladım ve oldukça memnun kaldım. Konumu finans merkezine yakın olduğu için çok avantajlıydı; ulaşım açısından merkezi bir noktada olduğu için işlerimi rahatlıkla halledebildim. Ev son derece temiz, düzenli ve konforluydu. İhtiyaç duyabileceğim her şey düşünülmüş, bu da konaklamamı çok daha keyifli hale getirdi. Ev sahibi de iletişim konusunda ilgili ve yardımcıydı. İstanbul'a tekrar geldiğimde gönül rahatlığıyla tekrar tercih edeceğim bir yer. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Konumu bizim için çok avantajlıydı hastaneye gidip gelmek oldukça rahat oldu. Ev son derece temiz, düzenli ve konforluydu. İçeri adım attığımız andan itibaren kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. Ev sahibi son derece nazik, ilgili ve her konuda yardımcıydı. Konaklama boyunca hiçbir sorun yaşamadık, her şey düşünülmüş ve özenle hazırlanmıştı. Bu kadar temiz, huzurlu ve rahat bir yerde konaklamak bizim için büyük bir şanstı. Tekrar bu bölgeye geldiğimizde kalacağımız adres artık belli. Her şey için Damla hanıma gönülden teşekkür ederiz.

Temiz ve konforlu bir daireydi, çok memnun kaldık. Hem otogara hem de hastaneye yakın olması konum olarak bizim için büyük avantaj oldu. Dairede gerçekten her şey düşünülmüştü, ihtiyacımız olan hiçbir şey eksik değildi. Ev sahibi de son derece ilgili ve yardımseverdi, aklımıza takılan her konuda hemen dönüş yaptı. Geç çıkış imkanı sağladığı için de ayrıca teşekkür ederim. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim, fırsat olursa tekrar tercih ederiz.
The place is really clean and comfortable. Only downside is that it looks like there was a leak some time ago and the ceiling in the bathroom is not in the best condition

description:
The apartment is located in calm, safe and central place. There are a lot of mall, shopping center, markets around the area. Also gardens/parks in a walking distance. By walking distance is 5 mins to bus stop, 10 mins to metrobüs. The apartment has about thirty five (35) bus routes. 15 mins from Sisli Center and 20 mins from Mecidiyeköy square by walking.
Shared kitchen and the apartment has all equipments; refrigerator, Hoover, oven, washing machine, dish washer, hair drier and iron.

reviews.text: Mehmet is a very great host.Always very helpful about almost anything and always shares his food and there is unlimited tea.The house and room is as described.Ventilator and Tv functioning properly.

I spent a good day in Mehmet’s house. He is a friendly and nice person. He cooked meal and invited me to the dinner.
The room and house was as described.
It was clean, and enough for one person.
Mehmet is a nice guy, social, allows you to get your privacy, give great tips "advices" about locations and transportation, and he loves to know about others' culture
Mehmet is really a great and wonderful host he’s so caring and understanding I will advice you all to choose mehmet for good hospitality

All I can say if you will stay with Mehmet then you will lucky for many reasons. He is very friendly and kind. He is very helpful if you want something or need something in Istanbul. Also all the time he invited me for breakfast, dinner, and sometimes lunch. I had a great time with him

description:
My flat is bright, sunny and fresh. It is very central. You can go to the metro and Istiklal Street in 5 min. by walking. You will have your own double-size bed in the private room but we use the kitchen and bathroom together.
I have two cats, welcome if you love cats and local experience. My apartment is safe the street is quiet.
Shops, cafes, and restaurants are near the home.
I will help you if need something.
See you!

reviews.text:
Pros:
-Ayşe is a great communicator and very friendly. This made the booking and check-in very flexible.
-The cats are cute
Cons:
-My biggest problem was cleanliness. I have dust allergies. It looked fairly clean in the photos but in reality there were spider webs in the corners of the room, a lot of dust along the floor boards, etc. The duvet was very old and stained with no cover on it.
-I don’t even think there is a picture of the room I actually stayed in. It felt more like I was staying in someones closet rather than a guest room. There was random stuff everywhere. One of the curtains was on a table. The wardrobe doors were broken off. There was a huge vacuum in the room. Suitcases everywhere. The door didn’t even actually shut.
-The photos seem like they are outdated and from when the apartment hadn’t been moved into yet. The apartment is actually very cluttered.
Other good things to know:
-The description doesn’t mention all the other rooms in the house are also rented on Airbnb. Everyone was really nice. But the host said they were friends, when really they are also guests. This gives more of a hostel vibe then being a guest in someone’s house. I use Airbnb because I don’t like hostels..
-The apartment is old. The floors are loud and the doors are loud. You can hear neighbors upstairs.
-Mosquitos in the room made it very hard to sleep.
Stay here if you’re on a budget and like cats and a more communal vibe. Again, everyone was friendly. But the host should reinvest in the apartment because people are paying to stay there.

I really loved staying in Ayses apartment. If you want a home away from home this is the place to be! The room and the apartment was exactly as described everything was very nice and cosy. The place is very central, the Taksim square, the istiklal shopping street and the Galata tower is in walking distance. There are many nice places to eat, supermarkets and antique shops in the area and it has a nice atmosphere.
Ayse was a wonderful host, she made me feel very welcome in her home, was helpful and caring with everything and gave me a lot of good recommendations for my stay in Istanbul. I couldn’t have been happier with the accommodation and I am really happy to have gotten to know Ayse. If I come back to Istanbul I would choose Ayses home again and I really recommend it to anyone traveling to Istanbul:)
Awesome host, exactly as it’s described and Ayse let’s you know exactly what to expect before confirming. Highly recommend.

Communication was excellent and the host was extremely helpful right till the end. The house is beautiful and the location made it easy to walk to key locations
Would definitely stay again :)

Awesome place located at an awesome neighbourhood!! Well located within a few minutes walk to one of the best kahvalti restaurants and others in Istanbul, and the place itself is clean and lovely. Will definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

description:
It is located in Şişli 5 min to bus station ,15 minutes walk to metro Station and cevahir AVM.., 8 min to profilo AVM, you can walk to Trump towers and metrobus line
Also you can use the Metro from the Airport ☺️
You can easily access to any place in Istanbul and I will help you as much as I can

reviews.text: Gaith didn't seem to be a bad guy and I didn't want to write a bad review, but unfortunately after I had to kill 4 blood sucking bugs during my stay (those weren't bed bugs either, some sort of ticks that caused my legs to get over 12 bites within a stay of 1 night. Isn't that lovely..), I'll have to be completely honest with my review. The place smelt rather bad, the kitchen was dirty and the bathroom looked like nobody cleaned it properly in years. There's just no value for your money with place.
Good value. Location is not the best but not bad. Overall I had a very good stay. thank you very much for everything! cost. privacy. good place to rest.

Overall, I had a great time to live there. All equipments didn't have any problems and my host is a really kind person. However, If you wanted to get an "ikamet" which means a permission of temporary residence in Turkey, I wouldn't recommend this place because he has a difficulty getting a document that is need when you apply for ikamet. This place is really good for a person who wants to stay in a short term.
Güler yüzlü ve yardımsever bir ev sahibi Gaith.
Gaith son derece sakin, efendi dost canlısı bir insan. İhtiyaçları giderme konusunda sürekli yardımcı oldu ve istenilen her an ulaşılabilir idi. Gönül rahatlığıyla konaklanabilir.

description:
Charming and newly furbished flat right in the center of Cihangir, Taksim. It is in a very nice neighborhood with lots of nice cafes, groceries, and shops. Convenient for max 3 people. There are 24 hours of hot water and a heating system.

A cozy open kitchen with all the appliances, a nice and open private terrace, a new bathroom, and a comfortable sitting and sleeping area. There is an extra room in the back for the guest with a foldable sofa.

It is in a quiet area and very central

reviews.text: I had an amazing stay! The place was exactly like the photos – beautifully designed, clean, and cozy. The large balcony was a fantastic spot to sit and enjoy the sun. The host was highly responsive and made everything easy. The location couldn't have been better, with coffee shops and local bars right at the top of the stairs outside, and just a short walk to Galataport and the main bridge. I would highly recommend staying here.

The stay was great. The apartment is very comfortable, with good beds, a well-equipped kitchen, a spacious balcony, and it’s located in a lively neighborhood. There’s a lot to see within walking distance. If you’re in good shape, you can even walk to the historic area of Sultanahmet. The ferry to Kadikoy is also nearby. Taxis are inexpensive, I recommend using Uber. It’s a pity we didn’t meet the host in person; it’s always nice to talk to a local. The apartment and its location are truly recommended!

I had an amazing experience staying at Ömer’s place for a week in Turkey! From the moment I arrived, everything was smooth and welcoming(thanks to Dilek!). The check-in process was easy, and the apartment was exactly as described, very clean, stylish, and equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay.
The location was perfect, close to public transport, great cafes and restaurants, and beautiful sights. Whether you're visiting Turkey for the first time or returning, I can't recommend this place enough.
Thank you again for your hospitality, I would love to stay here again on my next trip!
A wonderful stay and highly recommend.

I booked this place last minute as I was unsure where I wanted to stay in Istanbul, but this neighborhood was PERFECT. Quiet, but a short walk right up the stairs there are bars, restaurants, and coffee shops. Plenty to explore in the neighborhood and I felt very safe. The place itself is spacious and perfect for one or two people, and I loved having a terrace with a sea view. 🥰 The host provided video and photos for how to find the place, because without that I think it would have been very difficult. They even graciously accepted a late check-out request. Definitely glad this is the one I picked! 😊

This is a gorgeous apartment which has everything you need from cooking utensils to spices, tea, sugar and coffee. Also bottled water was left in the fridge. The apartment is very clean and looks unique. It was a lovely 9 day vacation! The area outside is full of lively bars which fill the streets. The owner stayed in touch via wats app which was really helpful. A lovely area but won’t suit anyone with walking difficulties as you have to walk down a number of steep steps to access the apartment. Lots of supermarkets around for shopping and plenty of eateries to choose from. Overall a lovely place to stay. Only 45 mins from the airport which cost around £15 in English money!

reviews.text:
Great location with many cafes/restaurants on a door step, galata tower is just a few mins walk, so is Istiklai street. Funicular to get to Karakoy (with many great restaurants and a ferry) very near as well so you do not need to climb if you do not feel like.
The apartment was clean, comfortable mattress and decent bedding. Some sort of tiny bedside tables/shelves would be useful, bedroom does not have black out curtains. Sugar, coffee, tea, kitchen paper towels in the kitchen would be nice to have.
Also, if you have a heavy luggage do keep in mind that the apartment is on 4th floor.
Internet was working well.
The host was responsive apart one day when electricity was gone in the whole block. That day we were locked out of the apartment as the electronic keypad was not working and provided key to the main door in case of emergency was not working - wrong key. So we were stuck outside with a baby for 4 hours.
Overall it was a great stay and the host was helpful. Thanks!

Both my wife and I really enjoyed our stay. It was walking distance to the metro and funicular, and had many nearby cafes, eateries, grocery stores, and the main attraction (Galata Tower).
The kitchen was complete with amenities which we very happy to cook our own meals during our stay. The units is very clean and very well maintained.
Host was very responsive and was very helpful in answering questions.
Something to consider is the unit is located on the 4th floor with no elevator facilities. We found it a challenge to transport our luggage along a narrow spiral staircase.

Very clean and perfect communication. Nevzat was very helpful and the apartment was exactly what we needed. Bathroom in the bedroom, and noise due to the (great) locationn, are inconveniences to be taken into account though

Well i have stayed at many place in Istanbul but this one is so perfect that makes the difference…
First of all the location is so perfect and central that you can easily reach there by Sishane Metro Station (just 100 metres walk maybe less) and from there you can reach anywhere you want in the city… It is right in the heart of the city where you can find everything you want… Taksim Square and Karakoy ferry port is just 10 minutes walking so you wont have problem going anywhere you wish anytime you want cause you wont have problem finding any metro from which you can access to the whole railway system of Istanbul
Additionally the house is just as shown in the pictures and it is so clean that i think is something that makes the most sense these days… Check in is self and Nevzat is so helpful for providing anything you want… The host is perfect and very helpful…
I can easily say that i would definitely stay again in the same place many times or maybe i would stay at no other place rather than that
Thanks a lot Nevzat for everything

The cosy compact apartment was just perfect for me since i was solo travelling.
The bathroom and bedroom are small - so just right for one person. The living and kitchenette are very comfortable with all the basics in place. I slept comfortably and made my own breakfast in the kitchenette!
Few things can be better: 1) the shower head kept dropping from its fixture, so that was a bit annoying.
2) i bumped my head on the washbasin cabinet since it’s too close/compact.
3) i took the 4th floor apartment but the building has no elevator: the staircase is winding and narrow, with sensor lights. I had difficulty bringing my suitcase up and down. If I had multiple bags, then i would skip this one since it is quite difficult without the space, lights and no extra hand.
Nevzat was quick in responding to all questions and even allowed a late check-out. His directions to find the place were clear & precise - super helpful since this is a very busy neighbourhood and easy to get lost. Thanks!

description:
“SEAVIEW GRAND”- BOSPHORUS with a breathtaking view of the Bosphorus on which you can enjoy watching the joyful traffic of ferries, cruises and sails.
Huge view of the Bosphorus Bridge and two continents come together in your apartment.
You can sit and enjoy this mesmerizing view while you are taking a sip of your drink after having discovered the beauties of Istanbul.
You can easily get access to the apartment with an elevator in the building which is perfect for the elderly.

reviews.text:
Seaview Grand Apartment was the most beautiful, best airbnb I've ever stayed in. The stunning, majestic view of the Bosphorus Sea is worth it itself.
Located in the Cihangir neighborhood (Beyoglu district) off Istanbul, tucked on a hill within 10 minute walk to Taksim and Galata. This flat is a very spacious 3 bedroom apartment with a huge living room as you can see through the photos, which can comfortably fit 6 people (2 per room) or even more if you stay on the couches. Everything you need is here on arrival - enough clean towels, house slippers.. to a fully equip kitchen. There is a washer/dryer in the bathroom also.
Communication is fast, easy and direct via WhatsApp or airbnb. There is a lift to the 4th floor for those that don't want to take the stairs.
The only thing to note is that to walk to this apartment, you will have to take a good amount of stairs/hills from the main road (off the Findikli tram stop) - in case you have a lot of luggage or have elderly people in your group. But of course, taxis are readily available everywhere.
I don't need to say more, the photos and reviews of this place speaks for itself. Most highly recommended!!

Apartment as described in a good location close enough to tourist spots. Good amneties within the apartment, we didn’t cook but kitchen looked well equipped.
Great view of the Bhosporus from living room and two of the bedrooms. Worth noting loud horn can be occassionally heard from passing ships/boats in the morning for any light sleepers.
Apartment is also on a sloped road and will involve some down/uphill walking if not taking taxis.
We enjoyed our stay and the host was always available for questions.

The apartment is really beautiful and unbelievable view of the Bosphorus .You immediately feel comfortable modern & stylish furnishings and super clean. Everything you need to get started can be found in the flat . The flat is fully equiped (Shampoo, Showergel, Towels, Soap, Bed Linens, Coffee, Tea ,Water and full kitchen utensil.) . The location is convenient because the T1 tram is very close and you can take it to the Galata Bridge and the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia. We felt very safe walking home to the apartment each night. There are many great restaurants nearby, and it is a short walk to Taksim Square. The host is extremely friendly, helps where he can, answers really quick Booking this apartment was a 100% good choice.

Overall this is was a great flat for my family. Hosts were very communicative and helpful throughout our stay. The apartment itself has amazing views and was representative of the photos. Neighborhood is hilly which we knew (hence the views) but there is an elevator in the building and a kids park nearby that the little ones loved. With cute cafes and a taxi stand around the corner, we would recommend for those seeking a hip, central hood that isn’t swarming with tourists.

Beautiful place with a stunning sunrise view of the Asia side.
Very comfortable with fast wifi, well equipped kitchen, and two balconies with great views of the bosphorous. Just a note that it is one and a half baths, so if you have 6 people there will be one shower to share between everyone. With our 4 people it was not too big of a hassle and the views made up for it.
Host is super responsive and has great local recommendations worth trying out.
Location is super convenient to Chihangir cafes and restaurants as well as Galata port, trams, palaces, and Taksim.
Highly recommend and will stay again!

description:
Our apartment has a modern and elegant look, located in the very center of Istanbul. You will enjoy the comfort of walking to all the city's major tourist attractions and centers of interest.

The interiors were furnished with your comfort and luxury in mind. Enjoy relaxing with comfortable bedrooms and a spacious living area.

We want to create a magnificent Istanbul experience for you. Make unforgettable memories. We'll be happy to welcome you.

reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay at Cihan abi's place.
very close to great surroundings, 24/7 security, very friendly and helpful staff at the residence, responsive, problem solving and host, Cihan was very responsive and accommodating. The place was clean and comfortable. The location is central and minutes away from the Metro and Taksim.We really appreciated the private parking.Cihan helped us with luggage storage after we checked out. I would highly recommend it!

Great place to stay near taksim, a few minutes walk, a bit of an uphill but after just 5 to 10 to taksim square, istiklal street or metro. Nice kitchen with everything you need, oven, big fridge, washing machine, toaster, all you need for cooking too. Apartment and bathroom very clean, got washing machine and drying rack too, too bad its only one bathroom but that seemed to be the case for all rentals of this size we looked into around taksim area. Cihan was very quick to respond, and if we needed anything quick or had any questions the building had 24hrs security always at reception which felt very safe and was convenient in case you get locked out or need anything. We got lucky with early check in and check out. We were a group of 5 and this was a great fit in terms of location, walkability, cleanliness, safety. Great value for money

We did find it difficult to check in, the male receptionist didn't seem to know much despite me showing him the airbnb confirmation email etc.Luckily our driver sorted it out..
Excellent communication from our host. Helped with connecting Netflix and WiFi.
Sauna a bit hit and miss sometimes it was on other days had to ask them to switch it on .steam room not working..pool fantastic always heated.
We really loved the apartment was exactly what we expected from photos etc .

Cihan was very responsive and accommodating. The place was clean and comfortable. The location is central and minutes away from the Metro and Taksim.
Cihan helped us with luggage storage after we checked out. He also helped with transfer to the airport.

L’appartement paraît plus grand en photo mais est fidèle à la description et aux photos.
Fonctionnel et bien équipé, Cihan se charge immédiatement de remédier aux petits manquements (micro-ondes et torchons livrés 10mn après la demande)
Insonorisation vraiment inexistante et rue en contre bas très bruyante + mosquée.
Pas de rideaux/stores occultants donc lumière directe (nuit/jour).
La literie est confortable et le balcon idéal pour faire sécher le linge au soleil.
À 15mn de marche (en montée) de la place Taksim pour prendre bus/metro.
Qqs restaurants locaux et très bons à proximité.
Sauna et hammam ne peuvent fonctionner en même temps, il faut choisir et demander leur mise en route 1h avant.
Piscine bruyante mais température de l’eau appréciable. Salle de sport fonctionnelle.
Le personnel de la résidence n’est pas très jovial mais les hôtes (Cihan et Murat) sont très gentils et arrangeants (checkin anticipé et transfert en Van organisés en supplément).
Je recommande fortement

description: This apartment is located in Beyoglu Istanbul. This is a economic mini studio apartment which has an independent entrance.

reviews.text: The location is perfect, right next to Sishane metro, and was easy to find and check in thanks to the instructions. It's a bit small, more of a room than an apartment, but for two people sharing a bed it's all you need. Bathroom was very clean and comfortable and there is a little kitchenette to prepare drinks or even food. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again.

I had a perfect night's sleep in this nice little ground-floor flat. It was spotlessly clean, the bed was comfortable, and there was even a cold bottle of water waiting for me in the fridge! And you can't beat the location or price. I will definitely stay with Volkan again on my next visit.

The apartment was as described - it was a bit smaller than I was expecting but fine for one person for a few days. It was located in a great area close to the metro and lots of restaurants. If you are a light sleeper make sure to bring ear plugs as it’s located in a busy area and there is no soundproofing. Host was very easy to communicate with, always very helpful and quick to respond and provided very easy check in instructions.

The apartment was exactly as pictured. The aircon seemed to be on a timer so it wouldn’t stay on all night and subsequently it was quite hot in there.
The room itself is very clean and well equipped. The tiles in the bathroom could have been more clean, but overall it was a great place to stay in the centre of Istanbul.
Communication was great and the check in/check out process was really easy.

We had a very nice stay. Volkan replied immediately, gave clear self check-in instructions, and there was always 'staff' nearby who could come to the apartment within 15 minutes if we needed help. When our toilet didn’t flush upon arrival, someone came to fix it right away. When our toilet paper was almost finished, we received new rolls.
The apartment is brighter than it appears in the photos, thanks to two street-facing windows. I had feared it would be too dark, but that wasn’t the case. The location (New European Quarter) is great—close to Galata Tower, Taksim Square (full of restaurants and shops), and fancy hotels like the Pera Palace, where Agatha Christie wrote Murder on the Orient Express.
Do note that the area is noisy both day and night, and the flat is not well insulated against sound. Streetlights prevent full darkness, even with curtains. Light sleepers may want to bring earplugs and a sleep mask. Bus, metro and train stops are 3-10 min away—leading to the 'Old city'.

description: Experience one of Maçka's most unique stays in this stylish two-bedroom duplex penthouse with a private terrace and beautiful sea views. Perfectly located between Nişantaşı and Beşiktaş, this spacious apartment is hosted by Homie Suites and combines modern comfort with an exceptional outdoor space. Whether you're visiting Istanbul with family, friends, or for business, you'll enjoy seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, and everything you need for a memorable stay

reviews.text:
We couldn't be happier with our stay. After our first Airbnb fell through we found this place and contacted hosts who responded promptly and offered us an earlier check in. The place it self was extremely easy to find and check in with following the instructions provided. We were so pleased to find it matched both the description and pictures.
The aircon was a blessing given the heatwave being experienced by Europe over the week in which we stayed.
The balcony view was lovely.
the kitchen had basic equipment but enough for us to get by. Two bottles of water supplied which we popped in the fridge for cold refreshing water after a day exploring. Nespresso pods supplied for coffee in the morning.
Beds very comfortable.
Shower pressure good
Everything was clean
Supermarket right underneath for basics, and a Migros not a far walk away.
A short walk to a ferry port, a little further for Tram but very reachable
Very proactive hosts reaching out and checking in
Great
Good connections

Overall, we had a great stay. The location was excellent—close to everything we wanted to do, with a beautiful view. The beds were comfortable, all of the A/C units worked well, and the Airbnb had everything we needed for our trip.
There were a few areas that could use improvement. The floors weren’t very clean when we arrived, the water was unavailable at one point, and the elevator was out of service for a few days during our stay. The balcony doors also seemed loose and could use maintenance, and having a few more towels available would have been helpful.
Despite these issues, we enjoyed our stay overall and appreciated the convenient location and amenities.
We had a wonderful stay. Great location, clean apartment, responsive host, photos are accurate, and easy to check-in check-out. Internet connection was good for working from both floors.

The house is on a gentle slope in the upmarket neighbourhood of Nisantasi/Bekistes. It is a few minutes' (6) walk to the ferry boats that connect you with the rest of the metropolis. It is also a 7-minute walk from Macka Park where you can catch a panoramic funicular or have coffee at the local cafe. The taxi station is also 30-seconds down the road.
There are vegetable and fruit shops at the doorstep as well as a Carrefour and smaller supermarkets right next door.
3 minutes down the road, there is a lovely bookshop that also serves light lunches and breakfast.
The house is on the 5th floor WITH an elevator. It has a panoramic balcony accessible by both bedrooms, overlooking the boats on the Bosphorus.
It has everything you need in the kitchen.
It has a smart TV and a washing machine. There is an A/C in each bedroom and one in the living room.
Bathrooms are spacious and amenities were nice.
10/10 would book this again.

WE HAD AN AMAZING STAY IN THE APPARTMENT. TOP LOCATION! IF YOU TRAVEL WITH KIDS ALSO, BECAUSE AN AMAZING PARK IS 2 MIN FROM THE APPARTMENT. AMAZING INTERIOR DESIGN. CLEAN AND COMFORTABLE. EVERYTHING LIKE ON THE PICTURES. THE COMMUNICATION WAS REALLY NICE. THEY HELP YOU WITH EVERYTHING. HAPPY THAT I CAN SAY, THAT WE HAVE NOW SOMETHING LIKE A SECONDE HOME IN ISTANBUL. THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING

description:
The adress is very easy to find and its 3 minutes to sishane metro station and Istiklal street (most popular street in Ist).Taksim square 15 min. by walking
Live like a local in my high ceilinged apartment with balcony near the Galata Tower!

Our building age more than 100 years and historical building. There are special handmade embroidery designs in the room .

Accommodates up to 4 people which make it perfect for families,friends and work retreats.

reviews.text:
My stay was wonderful! The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared. The key locker system made check-in/out seamless, which I really appreciated after a long day of travel.
The neighborhood was safe, quiet, and conveniently located, with easy access to local spots.

Great location and clean and cozy one bedroom flat. The apartment does not have an elevator so if you have big bags need to consider this or contact Ahmet who was super helpful and sent someone to help me out with my bags. The communication was super smooth and I enjoyed my stay very much.

First of all, place is even lot better than photos. Location is exactly at the heart of İstanbul but also quite peaceful and calm. Ahmet is very easy to communicate and helpful, worth every second and definitely want to visit again🙏

The place was truly amazing!
It was spacious, very comfortable, and perfectly clean, which made our stay really enjoyable. The location could not have been better, with plenty of bars and restaurants just around the corner and Galata within walking distance. One of the best parts was definitely the terrace, located right in front of a beautiful church, where we were able to watch the sunrise and enjoy a wonderful view of the sea.
The host was very responsive and extremely helpful throughout our stay, always ready to assist us whenever we had a question. We really appreciated the flexibility, as we were able to check in earlier than expected, and it was also possible to safely store our luggage in a locker, which made everything so much more convenient.
This place is a must!

Ahmet was an incredible host. the place was clean and well maintained, although the beds were just a little uncomfortable but as I only stayed 2 days that did not matter to us.
the location was great as everything was in walking distance.
Ahmet himself was so accommodating and responsive. with a added fee he accommodated us with a later check out which was really appreciated.

description:
Situated in the heart of Istanbul, across from the Galata Tower we have tastefully decorated 2 apartments which are located within a historical building.

Each apartment has a double bedroom, a fully equipped kitchen, free WIFI, fridge, mini bar and an LCD TV. Hair dryer and personal care products are provided in the bathroom.

Excellent location with restaurants, coffee shops and access to public transport all within walking distance.

reviews.text:
We loved this artistic apartment that is in front of the Galata Tower!
Very well decorated, you could feel atmosphere of history and very helpful host. The hosts have a very nice art gallery very close by that you should check out. If you need anything, they help right away. My husband and I had a cup of coffee with Aydin at their beautiful art gallery. Communication and fast help when we needed made our stay even more comfortable.
Very clean apartment, comfortable bed, hot shower and very warm in a middle of winter.
We will be back!

Amazing, artistic apartment, really comfortable, clean, well suited for short and long stay, situated in the best place, just next to Galata tower.
Big thanks to Aydin and his wife, they are the lovelest host that I came across in a while 🙏
I strongly recommend this place!
Location is perfect house need cleaning if you’re staying for a long time wont be fit as it is not equipped with washing machine and kitchen is small

Ev Galatanın dibinde (gerçek anlamda:) Uyurken sesten rahatsız oluyorsanız tercih etmeyin gürültü çok fazla ama konumu için değer. 1. Kat ama bina asansörsüz olduğu için avantajlı. Konumu çok iyi. Aydın beyin eşi çok yardımcı oldu. Giderken terlik almayı unutmayın lavaboda ve girişte sıkıntı yaşamamak adına :) bir de zemin ve halı temizliği daha güncel yapılırsa terliğe ihtiyaç duymazsınız. Teşekkürler

Ev gayet güzel, mutfağı küçük ama duş wc ve odalar gayet iyi. Güzel esiyor, hava alıyor. Tek sorun ilk katta olması o yüzden gece boyunca dışarının gürültüsü içeriye geliyor maalesef. Ama konum olarak çok merkezi, galatanın hemen yanı :)) Genel olarak biz memnun kaldık, ev sahibi çok iyi ve güzel iletişim kurduk :)

description:
Our apartment is a studio apartment.

It has AIR CONDITIONING, a kitchen, bathroom, toilet and balcony.
It is 2 minutes away from the beach and the jogging track.
It is in a perfect location to get a nice sea breeze in the morning :)
Ideal for bus stops, minibuses and private vehicles.(You can easily find a parking space)
Have a nice day...

reviews.text: Ev sahibine teşekkürler çok güzel ilgilendi ve sunduğu imkanlar fazlasıyla yeterliydi. Ev fotoğraflarda gözüktüğünden çok daha güzel, ilk girdiğimizde çok şaşırdık açıkçası. Manzarası mükemmel, akşam terasa çıkıp huzurlu ve sessiz bir şekilde zihninizi rahatlatabilmeniz ve bunu şehrin göbeğinde yapabilmeniz büyük bir velinimet. Yakınında restorant, market mevcut temel ihtiyaçlarınızı rahatlıkla karşılayabilirsiniz. İhtiyacınız olan çoğu şey evde mevcut hatta fazlası bile var. Nargile takımı, nargile tütünü, sipsi ve alüminyum folyosuna kadar mevcuttu. Böyle bir manzarada da bu keyfi yaşayabildiğimiz için ev sahibine tekrardan teşekkürler, tekrardan misafiri olacağız👍🏻

Hizmetten çok memnun kaldım. Ev gayet temiz ve kullanışlıydı. Eşsiz bir manzarası vardı tıpkı fotoğraflardaki gibi. Can bey de iletişimi kuvvetli ilgili birisi. Kendisinden bundan sonrada kiralama yapmaya devam edeceğim gibi görünüyor. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz 👍🏼

The view sells this place, it is beautiful and exactly as advertised. The host is proactive, kind, responsive etc. It is close to public transport, but as said in other reviews, you must go early and be prepared to wait. The only minus is the apartment amenities, which have stains (curtains, walls), and dust inside the room, which can be cleaned.
I felt like at home. The host, Mr. Can, was very helpful. The location of the house, the balcony and the view were great. The house was very clean. Thank you very much Mr. Can for everything.

The place is really cool there is some pros and cons

Pros : great view, the place is really clean nothing to say about it
Cons : location not the best in my opinion, 3rd floor with no elevator so u will have to take some stairs
But i think it's a great choice for a budget travel

description:
A lovely Ottoman-era wooden house , located in the very heart of the historical peninsula of Istanbul.
Our flat is on the ground floor of a traditional Ottoman house which was restorated in 2013. The place is located in the center of the historical peninsula of Istanbul. It's a few minutes walk to the metro and tramcar stations, Süleymaniye mosque and Beyazit Tower in the main campus of Istanbul University. Within a ten minute walk you will find yourself in Sultanahmet region and Grand Bazaar.

reviews.text:
Pros:
1-landlord and owner are so supportive, they helped us in many things, to manage to arrange a ride from/ to the airport with very good price. They were very responsive, they reply so quickly to any issue we had and tried to solve it as soon as they can. They helped us to do the PCR test at home and get the results quickly.
Also they were very helpful to let us check in early as our flight arrives early in the morning.
2- the flat is exactly as shown in pictures.
3- the flat location is near to everything, many of the touristic location can be a walking distance, or 2 min walk to metro station or 5 min walk to tram
Cons:
1- the flat location is in a very very crowded area and steep streets and this is normal due to it is located in the old city
2- the flat is all made of wood and this makes it no sound proof at all, you can hear each and every little sound in the street and this is very annoying if you plan to sleep after 8 AM in the morning.
Also you can feel all the steps and movement of the neighbors at the upper floor due to wooden floors.
Recommendations:
1- it would be better if there are a microwave or oven in the flat because it was hard to reheat any leftovers.
2- it will be better to make sure that the flat is totally clean before check in to avoid disappointment

I have lived in the apartment for a week. The location is absolutely fantastic, it is in the very heart of Istanbul, 3 minutes walk to Suleymaniye Ьosque, with a very friendly neighborhood.
There is everything you need in the flat; It has two rooms, a corridor, and a well furnished kitchen; it’s bigger than in the photos.
The host responded fast and was very helpful. I recommend staying in this apartment.

Very comfortable apartment in a great location. Everything is in a walking distance. Not exactly like pictures, but actually slightly better. The apartment has a small living/dining room that isn’t shown in the picture (it’s a different room from the one that has a sofa) Also the AC is in the bedroom and not in the sofa room as the pictures show. which made more sense to me anyway. I totally loved the place!

hello my fellow travelers if you want to be in the middle of what Istanbul can offer this is your place , you literally don't have to ride a car everything within 10 to 15 minutes walking except going to Taksim and beyond, very safe neighborhood many I mean many options of restaurants even there is a Playstation shop where you can go and compete with local players I felt at home the place is safe I come back at 3:00 4:00 a.m I was never bothered at all, takes about 3 minutes walking to reach the main Street to get a taxi , Erhan was great he checked on me everyday he helped me with everything I needed, they cover everything you need from towels hair dryer umbrellas full kitchen if you want to cook your own food hot water all day long heater in every corner, I couldn't ask for more to be honest with you great value highly recommended.

Öncelikle tarihi bir sokakta tarihi bir evde konaklamak güzel bir deneyimdi.
Ev tam olarak fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi. Mutfak gereçleri başta olmak üzere ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey mevcut. Eşyalar yeni ve tertemiz. Ev metroya çok yakın, gayet merkezi bir konumda. Evle ilgili sorun olabilecek tek husus ahşap yapısı nedeniyle ses yalıtımının zayıf olması. Bizim konakladığımız dönemde sokağa çıkma yasağı olması sebebiyle çok fazla etkilenmedik ama normal bir zamanda özellikle giriş kat için bu bir sorun yaratabilir. Ev sahiplerimiz ve Erhan Bey karşılaştığımız ufak sorunlar konusunda hızlı bir şekilde çözüm ürettiler. Sonuç olarak gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebileceğimiz sıcak ve samimi bir ev.

description:
''Kanyon, Özdilek and Metrocity are 4 minutes walking distance,
Levent Metro is a 5-minute walk,
In the most central location in the heart of the city

Easy Access to Anywhere You Want,
I will be happy to host you in this apartment, which I have provided with High Speed Wi-Fi and all the amenities that should be in a home.
'''Welcome in advance'''

reviews.text: We stayed here for 13 days and had a really good experience. The apartment was clean, tidy, and exactly as described. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, especially for a longer trip. The location was very convenient, with shops, restaurants, and transport all close by, which made getting around Istanbul easy. The host was responsive and check-in was straightforward. We would happily stay here again and would recommend it to others visiting Istanbul.

The location was convenient, allowing pets to stay and being within walking distance of the station and shopping mall.
Since there were only stairs, moving luggage in and out was a bit of a hassle.

Fantastic location close to subway, restaurants, malls and everything.
Even though it is located on a somewhat busy street, it was quiet, modern and comfortable.
Inside the apartment, everything seems like new.
Onder was terrific to work with. He always responded to any questions very quickly.

It was a nice stay, very good location. There are some shopping malls nearby. The apartment is big enough, there's a big and new fridge. You can find the necessary kitchen stuff to cook for yourself. Amazing view from the window!

Önder war ein sehr freundlicher, zuverlässiger und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation verlief jederzeit schnell und unkompliziert. Die Unterkunft entsprach der Beschreibung, der Check-in war reibungslos und wir haben uns während des gesamten Aufenthalts sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank für die Gastfreundschaft – wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und können Önder uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

description:
WELCOME TO OLD CİTY APARTMENTS
‘'With the most competitive price, in the comfort of Turkish hospitality as you were in your own home, in the heart of the Oldcity ...'’
During your staying you will be helped by special and unic stuff and you will be pleased with the friendly atmosphere of the “house”. At Old city.
3rd Floor Apartment , aparts with elegant decor complete the comfort of “home away from home”.
Please note that upstairs can be reach only by the stairs. We don't have elevator.

reviews.text: great stay in Istanbul. the apartment is as described. located right above a 24 hour cafe, moments walk from numerous resturants and a few minutes walk from the metro (Kumkapi station). apartment itself was clean and tidy as described and a great value base to explore Istanbul (especially if 4 people are staying).

The apartment is located on the third floor with no elevator, which can be inconvenient if you have a lot of luggage or mobility issues. Additionally, the building next door was completely demolished, giving the area a somewhat abandoned feel. I also noticed that the towels and bed linens had a musty smell, likely because they weren’t properly dried.
Another point to consider is that the apartment is situated at a busy intersection, and you can hear car horns until 1 or 2 AM and again starting at 7 AM, which can make it difficult to get a good night's sleep. While the apartment is close to a tram stop, you have to climb a rather steep hill to reach it, which can be tiring after a long day of sightseeing.
On the positive side, there was good communication with Murat, who was responsive and helpful throughout the stay.
In summary, the apartment would have been fine if I had paid less for it.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The space was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly responsive and thoughtful, making check-in and communication a breeze. Located near shops and restaurants. Highly recommended!

Everything was great. The location was nice and the neighbourhood is very walkable with lots of restaurants and markets around. The place was exactly as described and very clean. The only downside was that the flat is on the 3rd floor and there is no elevator, so it was a bit hard for us given all the luggage we had, but it was not a big deal. I would recommend.

The apartment was small but nice, with everything we needed for our stay. It’s in a great location - walking distance to main attractions and plenty of restaurants. It was clean, though not spotless. A couple of downsides: the A/C in the bedroom is positioned directly above the bed, so cold air blows right onto you at night, and the shower was missing part of the glass, so you have to be careful to avoid splashing water outside. Overall, a comfortable place in a convenient area.

description: This stylish, well-decorated (all wooden furniture is handmade), spotlessly clean, large, and unique suite has a high-quality bathroom and elevator in the great location in the Beyoğlu/Taksim district. Moreover, the magnificent panoramic view of Bosphorus (till Prince' Islands and Asian side) and Historical Peninsula (Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia, Süleymaniye Mosque, Galata Tower, along with other famous monuments) can be seen from its private balcony.

reviews.text: Breathtaking view! Cleanroom and very central. Looking over the historical Galatasaray and having a view of the Aya Sofia, Sultan Ahmet, and Topkapi, with the Princess Islands in the background. I could not stop taking photos from the balcony. The only caveat is that since it is in a prime location, very close to all attractions, that comes with a nightlife noise from cars of partiers who like to joyride late into the night. For me, the view and location, and the cleanroom with a kind and responsive host made it all worth it.

Great host and great space. Was exactly as described and host was very proactive and responsive. Only down sides were a tiny bathroom and not very strong water pressure, but otherwise would stay again. Sturdy, comfortable bed and spotless cleaning, view across the golden horn is as promised:. Beautiful.
Host and bookshop we're kind enough to watch our bags for us between checkout and our flight. Great stay, would stay again.

Bilge’s place was incredibly comfortable, spotlessly clean, and exceptionally cozy. It’s located on a peaceful and secure street with breathtaking sea view , and the beauty of entering the building through a charming bookstore made the stay even more serene. The location is unbelievably central—easily accessible by taxi, metro, or on foot. Bilge was also incredibly helpful.
I strongly recommend this place!

Absolutely amazing view. Brilliant location. Great communication. Clean and comfortable space. No kitchen but does have a microwave and fridge.
Thank you Bilge for a great holiday!

Everything was perfect, especially the host who was very friendly, very specific about everything and very discreet.
The place was clean enough, and looked exactly like the photos. Even it’s far from the sea, had a very beautiful view of the historical site.
If I had to say something negative it’s probably the noisy neighbourhood which is normal though, because of the school that has a football field and they’re playing football even on weekends till late and the central spot that the accommodation it’s located. With the windows closed it’s much better!
We enjoyed our time, we are recommending it, and we’ll definitely come back if we visit istanbul again🥳

description: My flat is very centrally located (in Sisli) and accessable from anywhere in town. One very small room with a single bed and wardrobe is ideal for a student.

reviews.text:
We loved our stay at Biray's! Very well located for our needs and very affordable. Biray was a lovely host that made us feel welcomed and very comfortable, just like we were visiting a friend. Her cat is the most amazing roommate we could ask for and we were very happy with her company.
The house was as messy as a friend's house which made it feel more homy, the room was clean and very comfortable and the internet worked perfectly.
I would recommend it and return, for sure!

We had booked the Biray Anil place for 6 night stay. The choice was made initially as it was an excellent location very near to the to Taksim .The room was very clean & comfortable The kitchen had all necessary items .Durring our stay Biray was out of town so we could not spend time with her The place is very well connected through local transport - bus stop metro is a in 10 minute walk.it is a great value for money and an excellent choice.

Biray is a very helpful and hospitable person. The apartment looks exactly as it is on the photos. The location is perfect! Central district with lots of shops, and the biggest shopping mall in Europe is also near. It was nice and comfortable to stay in this apartment!

The room is clean, nice and comfortable. Biray is a good host - friendly, full of recommendations and kind. Her cat is very cute and friendly. Lastly, the area is great -- very local with no tourists -- lots of great places to eat and explore, and well connected to transport (5-10 minute walk to the metro).

I will start my review with the wise Turkish people's saying: Cevahir is Istanbul, Istanbul is Cevahir! The thing that Biray didn't emphasize enough is that her neighbour is only the best shopping-entartainment mall in the entire world - Cevahir! :D
On a side note, there really isn't anything that a guest could complain about while staying at Biray's residence. The location is perfect, since it's also 5-10 minutes on foot to metro, that gets you to Taksim in just 2 stops. The room is nice, and so is the toalet, kitchen, and the balcony. Only bit of an issue can be a WiFi which reaches to around the door of the room. Regarding the hosts, Biray and her cat were very considerate and polite. We didn't get much of a chance to get to know Biray very well, but she certainly is a professional host and always ready to give you useful advices and insights of her city. Overall, for the price we payed, this place is a true bargain.

description: Welcome to our 2 bedroom cozy apartment with an unbeatable touristic location. It is large and spacious, thoughtfully decorated as family pattern, with Washing Machine, Microwave and fully equipped kitchen and other daily basic needs, which gives you a real city home feelings! It has situated just behind the great Blue Mosq & hippodrome.

reviews.text:
We had a fantastic stay and it was perfect for our family of five. The apartment had everything we needed, with a lovely view and a superb location that made getting around really easy. The host was extremely helpful and accommodating throughout.
The room was clean, warm, and very comfortable. While the interior is slightly dated, it didn’t take away from our experience at all—we felt completely at home.
It also offers excellent value for money, especially in a city that can be quite expensive for visitors. The stairs could be a bit tricky for very young children or elderly guests, but this wasn’t an issue for us.
Overall, we would definitely recommend staying here.

We will really miss the wonderful view over the Sea of Marmara and watching the sun set. The apartment is in the best possible location for the main sights of the old city of Istanbul. Walk 5 minutes and you are in the main Hippodrome with the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and, a few minutes further, the Topkapi palace and a tramline to the rest of the city.
The flat is not luxurious but it is adequate for a family stay, with a hob, dishwasher and washing machine. Sleeps four in one large rear bedroom in a large double and two twins, with an area off the lounge having a further large double. All very clean and ready for use, and located in an apartment block with an electronic entry (although the area was very safe to walk around). Recommend accepting the host's offer to arrange transport from and to the airport, which was efficiently organised and competitively priced. Muhammed's communications were responsive, helpful and friendly. A very happy, comfortable stay.

We were a party of five adults and the space worked very well for us; one bedroom with three beds (1 double) and then another double bed in a tuck away space close to the living/ sitting area. There were 3 sofas and so there was room to relax and to eat at the nice dining space. The hosts were very responsive and flexible and the place was clean. The bathroom and kitchen were also very user-friendly. The air conditioning was very effective so we were very comfortable. The location was amazing- close to the tram , main tourist sites and lots of restaurants. And the view from the flat was simply fabulous. Thank you to our hosts!

Ideal apartment for a family - walkable, beautiful view of Marmara Sea, quiet at night, comfortable home. Wonderful place to catch the sunset and lots of natural light. Up 2 flights of spiral stairs but just a few minutes from everything - supermarkets, restaurants, and blue/hagia. No trouble getting a taxi or walking home from the metro. Responsive host. No pantry/cooking essentials but fully equipped kitchen. Loved having laundry and dishwasher.

Great location, walkable to a lot historic places and restaurants. Apartment is as in pictures, comfortable for our 5 member family and furry friend. Host was great, helped us with transport from airport and loading luggage (we had a lot of it). Keep in mind that most of buildings in this area do not have elevator. We had very pleasant stay and would recommend.

description: Our apartment is located between Bağdat Street and the seaside promenade in one of Suadiye’s most central and desirable areas. Our building is among the closest residential buildings to the sea. Cafés, restaurants, shops and the seaside are all within walking distance. Suadiye train station is approximately 5 minutes on foot. Please note that seaside transportation does not cross to the European side; access is provided by train. The apartment is located on a quiet street.

reviews.text: Very clean and comfortable apartment, with all the amenities needed for a long stay, suitable for a couple. Looked exactly like the photos. The view from the terrace is amazing (the view is even nicer than in the photos). The apartment is in a safe and secure building in a residential neighbourhood near Bagdad Street, which is a trendy street on the Asian side, full of restaurants and some shops. The apartment is close to the water and a nice long walking trail (you can also rent bicycles). It is far from tourist attractions. The closest supermarket is a Gimtas branch, which is 6 minute's walk. It was easy to communicate with the host. The building does not have a lift so not suitable for people with mobility issues. The wifi speed is great in the living room.

The place was exactly like the photos and very clean. The locality is perfect, a few minutes walk from the main street and the train station. There are many facilities around, a big supermarket and lots of good restaurants and cafes just around the corner. The building is secure and the view of the terrace is outstanding, especially for the beautiful summer days. Our host, Mert, was very responsive and helpful. We loved our stay and would highly recommend it.

Ev çok temiz ve düzenliydi, fotoğraflardaki gibi hatta daha bile güzel. Konumu harika, hem toplu taşımaya hem de market, restoran gibi yerlere çok yakın. Ev sahibi inanılmaz kibar, anlayışlı ve iletişimi çok hızlıydı; her soruma hemen dönüş yaptı ve gerçekten misafirleriyle ilgileniyor. Konaklama boyunca kendimi evimde gibi hissettim. Kesinlikle tekrar gelmek isterim ve herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

I felt right at home during an extended stay. Nice apartment exactly as described. Location, location, location! You have easy access to Metro, the seaside, and shops for all your essentials. Yunus was very responsive and helpful.

We've stayed in Mert's apartment for a week. The location is just perfect. The beautiful seaside is in front of the house. You can go for a walk or ride a bicycle anytime you want. Also, you can reach Bağdat Street by taking a short walk, where you can find shopping stores, restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and more. The apartment is larger than in the photos and ideal for both short-term and long-term stays. There is also a little terrace with a great view, but unfortunately, because of the rainy season, we couldn't take advantage of it as much as we wanted. For remote workers like us, we've been working for our stay, and the internet was crucial for us, and we didn't have any problems.

description:

reviews.text:
We were a large group of 3 families so we took the whole building with its 3 flats for 5 days.
In terms of cleanness the building deserves the full mark - spotless!

The best flat is the upper one; it is a duplex, sunny, big, has a TV, 2 ACs; The middle one is the smallest but it was more than enough, tastefully decorated. The ground floor flat has a lovely small garden but its bedroom is small and very close to the street - which caused a little problem to the family that stayed in this flat.
The people responsible for the house are obviously professionals; they are doing a really good job, knows exactly what guests needs.
Gaye is such a great host, communicates very well and always ready to help, attended to all our requests with a big smile on her face.
The neighborhood was perfect - the real feel of locals way of live. A completely different feeling than crowded touristy places. Everyone in our group loved its streets, people and local market....
Transportation is not hard (not very easy either) - a 10 minutes walk to the nearest bus stop - another 10-15 minutes by bus to Eminonu where you can go everywhere.
In short, I had been to Istanbul more than 5 times, and stayed in different houses in different areas; I can honestly say, this has been my best experience so far, and Leyla's house certainly played a big part in this.
Definitely recommended.

This flat was great to stay in!
We were sent information on a cafe to tell the taxi driver to take us to from the airport where Gaye would meet us and walk us to the flat, as the flat is difficult for taxi drivers to find. Our driver had trouble finding the restaurant, bit we were able to call Gaye and she gave the driver directions, which was nice because we know no Turkish! Gaye was very helpful when we arrived, told us about getting around town and what to do, and recommended some good restaurants. She even set up the car from the airport that comes right to the front door. If we had any issues or questions she responded to my texts in a timely manner.
The flat is nice, has everything you would need for a comfortable stay. I liked the decor, it definitely is very cozy.
The neighborhood is nice and was a lot of fun to explore, lots of stores open late, as well as good restaurants and coffee shops. I think it's an older area, but I liked it, I got a real feel for the real Istanbul that I probably wouldn't have gotten with a hotel. The location is very close to the major touristic areas you will want to see. We opted to take cabs everywhere, we got them by the cafe on the main road, prices were good. It was a little difficult explaining to cab drivers how to get back, but of course we didn't know Istanbul. There are several restaurants on the same road with the same name, but we managed it!
It was a nice place to stay for a week with our toddler. Turkey is very good to children! There were other guests in the other flats but we hardly knew they were there. The flat is very clean and mostly quiet, and I felt safe going to a grocery store alone at night. It was nice to sit in the sitting room at night and unwind.
You do hear rosters, loud cats, and the call to prayer early in the morning, but I took it as part of the charm and mystique of visiting Turkey!
We really enjoyed our stay and I was glad I made the decision to stay at this place! More than just a place to sleep!

Leyla's house is really cute, clean, beds are comfy, just a nice feel all around - and very well located for us for our work there.
