reviews.text: thank you Özra for a wonderful stay. the apartment is amazing. the photos don't do it justice, it's very large, clean, comfortable and has everything you need. really lovely decoration inside, well equipped kitchen and a uper comfortable sofa and beds. it's right next to istiklal street and has so many dining and drinking options near by. a short stroll to Galata tower. great public transport links, was easy to walk to sultanhamet (where blue mosque, grand bazaar and hagia Sofia are) but if you don't like walking and exploring it's simple and easy to get public transport or a taxi there. we felt so at home and Özra was an amazing host who was easy to communicate with and very accommodating. if I'm ever back in Istanbul this is where I'd stay again.

Özra’s place is exactly how she described: convenient location, clean and spacious. Özra is very responsive before and during our stay. We had a problem with the shower drain and she had it fixed the same day. One evening the neighborhood lost power. She kept us informed with updates. The power came back on pretty soon. It is a very nice and comfortable place for us, with nice amenities. Thank you for your kindness.

Ozra's beautiful period apartment was just as described, only better. It was really spacious, with equal sized bedrooms (good for 2 couples sharing). Furnished with lots of interesting vintage stuff and quirky paintings. My husband was thrilled to find a guitar to play too! The kitchen was well equipped and the bathroom had a great walk-in shower. The weather in Istanbul was very cold and wet, but Ozra had made sure the heating was on and the apartment was really warm and welcoming , so we felt very comfortable for our entire stay. Her Instructions for access to the apartment were also really clear.
The location is busy above a Irish pub, but we were never disturbed as the apartment is on the third floor. Instead, you have great views in a great location- near the Istiklal Caddesi and Taksim Square for transport links to the airport, and interesting places to explore in all directions. We couldn't be more pleased with our choice to stay at Ozra's apartment. She is a really great host!

Özra is true a gem, and her place reflects that precisely.
My mother and I pretty much fell in love with this place. It’s vibrant, spacious, filled with beautiful art pieces, and above all it is super cozy.
The living room is spacious with a wonderful view of the city. The dining room is a plus. The bathrooms are super clean. The bedrooms are located at the quieter side of the building. The beds are super comfortable. The kitchen is filled with all the amenities you might need. The location is impeccable. It is a walking distance from anything you might need. A few steps from the famous istiklal street.
Özra was truly helpful and responsive. She didn’t hesitate to help out when I needed her.
This place is 10/10, and Özra deserves 10+/10.
We thank her for making us feel at home, and we look forward to stay at her place again.

Firstly Ozra is really lovely, responsive unless it's Sunday and very helpful as a host.
Location is great, central and a fab view of the Istanbul alley. Apartment is huge and bedrooms are spacious
Perhaps it's because we were there at the start of Winter, the heater was not working well on the rainy days - u can turn it to the max and it's only slightly warm at most. Ozra did tried to help and was responsive.
the building is old, so expect to hear your neighbours when they leave their apartments and also their creaking floors. Flooring worn and kitchen floor hinge also came off.
it didn't bother me but you can most definitely hear the live band below going at it until 1am
if you call a cab you have to be downstairs before it arrives as its a 1-way alley so cars can't wait for you.
Lastly. it was mentioned that shower floor floods - that is still happening
2. you have to walk up a flight of slippery marble stairs before you get to the lift.
But I still had a lovely stay!

description:
Featuring high ceilings, exposed brick walls,
unique decor, high-speed internet, this centrally-located three bedroom
apartment with living room..

Enjoy this newly renovated second floor loft with
balcony located in the Old Town Pera district
minutes by walking to Taksim square and Istiklal Street. this is the perfect location
for your Istanbul stay.

reviews.text: Aydin was the friendliest and most helpful host we’ve ever come across. He was helpful on the get go with parking and brining our bags up to our room. He had great recommendations of places to visit and eat in the area. The hotel room has a very nice aesthetic to it and has all the accommodations you would need especially for a long stay such as washer and plenty of storage space. I’ve stayed in five different hotels during my trip to Turkey and Aydins location was by far my favorite. The bedding especially was so clean and smelt so fresh, I felt like I was at home. The bathroom might be claustrophobic for bigger folk, but it was clean also nonetheless. Also, this place is the best value for having three rooms and 2 queens 1 twin. I loved how every guest had an actual bed to sleep on, not a pull out couch as all the other AirBNB’s for 5 people.

Aydin is decent and polite person. Didn't have any issues with finding the exact location of the flat. He was waiting for us there. Completely renovated, 2 double beds and a single one, enough space. Fresh fruits and water were left for us. Neighborhood is polluted and crowdy, but the host has no fault. However, it's 5-6 minutes to Taksim Square by walking. Everything is exactly like it's described. Thanks a lot for the warm welcome!

Aydin was my best host ever. He is very friendly, always available and willing to help. For example, he helped us set up an early taxi to the airport on our last day that turned out to be quite affordable.
The rooms are nicely renovated and feel good to stay in. The apartment was nicely warm during our stay which felt nice during our December stay. The combined toilet and shower is a bit special (see pictures) but works fine. The neighborhood can look a bit strange, especially in the dark, but we didn't have any problems at all and we found out that there is actually a big police station really nearby. Don't use the back alleys when arriving as they are unlighted.
Overall we found it great value (and we were only three so we had one room free) and would come again.

We had an amazing 1 week stay at Aydin's place. The apartment is spacious, clean and has everything one needs for a week stay - and in real life it also looks exactly like on the photos. The location is great (albeit a bit noisy) - close to Taksim/Istiklal/Galata. Communication with Aydin was just flawless - from booking and checking in to local tips and checking out. Highly recommended!

Aydin is the kindest, most responsive, friendliest host anyone could ask for. His flat is small but perfect and it is centrally heated so we were super comfortable and warm in spite of the freezing weather outside.
Aydin met us outside an hour earlier then the official check in time and helped us take our luggage upstairs. He took me for a walk around the neighbourhood to show me some of the local eateries and supermarkets and just generally helped me to orientate myself.
What really stood out was his willingness to let us stay until well into the evening when we were supposed to check out at at 11:00 because he had no one coming in straight after us. We were so grateful since our flight out of Istanbul was at 23:40!
What a generous gentleman. Thank you!

description:
This suite has a private kitchenette and a modern bathroom with a jacuzzi. The suite has very large windows, a spacious and useful layout. There is a room cleaning service every 3 days. You can reach historical places from our building in a 10-minute walk and visit the historical places of the old city and shop.
The Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapı Palace are some of them. The tram stops are about a 7-8 minute walk away.

reviews.text:
Spent 4 nights (New Year Eve included). Our stay was surprisingly good. The apartment was very cozy and provided us with the perfect base point to explore old Constantinople. We never rented a cab or took any public transport. Each day we walked by foot to all sites we marked for visiting. To cut it short, here's a summary:
Pros:
+ the location is perfect (10 min. from waterfront, 15-20 minutes from historic center, yet far away from large crowds)
+ noticeably fresh sea air in the morning
+ the place was very comfortable
+ clean bathroom with unlimited hot water
+ good cafes and restaurants within 100m
+ host was very responsive and helped with the parking
Cons:
- on 3-4 occassions some conjestion occurred on the street in front of the apartment leading to angry car horns noise. Street noise was not really an issue though.
- water pressure dropped for ~1h, but I assume this was not specific to the building.
Conclusion: will definitely book again if I visit Istanbul in the future!

Agia is a great host. The place is good, as described. Clean and cosy. A bit of noise in one occasion only from the tenants upstairs while taking the stairs back and forth (echo!), but was all fine otherwise. One needs to be careful with the stairs while taking the luggage. All in all, it’s worth what we paid for, and Agia is a great host (responsive, helpful and kind)!

Pros:
Check-in was easy and the host was very friendly. The room was nicely furnished and very clean. The whirlpool is a bit small for two people, but we still really enjoyed it. The location is close to many of Istanbul’s most famous sights, which makes it ideal for a short stay.
Cons:
The area is quite noisy, and we could hear a lot of street sounds. Noise isolation within the building was also very poor – we could clearly hear other guests watching TV or talking in their rooms at night. That made us a bit self-conscious about making noise ourselves. Also, someone had burned a small spot into the bottom of the TV screen, which was slightly annoying but not a big deal since we didn’t use the TV much. The Wi-Fi was sometimes too slow, so we often had to rely on mobile data – inconvenient, but not a major issue.
Overall:
All in all, a very nice apartment for the price.

Agia's budget-friendly, spacious apartment near the Grand Bazaar and Blue Mosque offered an excellent stay. The large bathroom is well-supplied, and the smart apartment with cool lighting features a comfy bed. Imren Lokantasi downstairs serves delicious meals, and nearby shops provide affordable, high-quality Turkish delight. Other stores offer an authentic, budget-friendly experience.
Loti Laundry, reasonably priced, is a big plus. Taxis are available but pricey; Agia arranged a cost-effective VIP transfer. Despite low water pressure, promptly addressed issues. The 3rd-floor location means stairs.
The ideal location, a 13-minute walk from the Blue Mosque, makes it a perfect base for exploring Istanbul. While trams are uphill, an easier walk makes transportation convenient. Thanks to Agia for a wonderful stay; highly recommend this well-equipped apartment for a delightful Istanbul experience!

Amazing place in the main center of Istanbul. If you would like to stay in the closest center to Grand Bazar and many beautiful places, there is no better place! The host is amazing. He helped us with parking the car, and was supportive on every step, offering help with literally anything.
The apartment itself is better than in the pictures. Fancy, high quality and comfortable. Equipped with everything what you need. Even if there were some problems with water (it is simply not there sometimes of the day) and the host was fixing the sink for two days, he took care of it professionally. I highly recommend this place to stay for single/couple trip in a private manner!

description:
Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby.

You’ll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text:
the Host was absolutely brilliant and very kind he accommodated me to come to the apartment five more hours early then check in and allowed me to stay a couple of hours after checkout to accommodate my flight.
the Host was always responsive the apartment is definitely worth more than what it has been listed for it was very comfortable and very clean the view was lovely and you have next year shopping markets very very close to you to get your groceries but just a little bit far from places of interest so you'll definitely need to consider hiring car or getting a taxi.
overall I think the apartment was great and anything bad that is said about the apartment I could truthfully say it's not correct the host the apartment was definitely worth a five-star.
by the way the apartment is sparkling clean there is not a single thing out of place
Great host. Clean and comfortable apartment with good AC and amenities.

It was totally smooth experience! The flat was clean and cozy, with multiple supermarkets and restaurants nearby, a western union location 5 minutes walk away, and good internet! Muhammed showed respect and attention, helped with all questions I got, and in general, I had a very good impression of living there. I really appreciate the fact that all communication happened in English! Highly recommend this residence!

The apartment was clean and modern, the night view was very pleasant. The host send us the accurate location on our arrival. Overall, we didn’t have any issue during our stay. The only thing to mention is that the apartment is so much smaller than how it looks in pictures.

It was a great experience of living in this apartment! Mohammad was extremely nice and understanding, he was ready to answer our questions and help us any day and any time. The apartment was like in the photos, everything was clean and worked well - air conditioning, TV, washing machine, iron. We liked that Mohammad also gave us extra pillows and duvet. We really felt like being at home and did not want to leave. Thank you for creating such pleasant atmosphere and making our staying in Istanbul amazing:)

description:
The apartment is in the 8 floor , with a perfect view. It is a perfect place for family members and its only takes one minute walk to go to super market and to restaurants and coffee shops. All our houses are 100 meters from the metro station.
And if you are a big fan of shopping you can visit 212 outlet shopping Mall, And Mall of Istanbul the biggest Mall of Turkey, where you can find everything you wish for.

reviews.text:
The apartment is spacious and mostly matches the description. However, the location leaves much to be desired. While the gated area itself is quite pleasant, the surrounding neighborhood is not ideal: there’s heavy traffic, noise, car exhaust, and no real places to walk around.
Inside the apartment, it’s clear that it needs some maintenance. The walls are dirty, and door handles are falling off (which could lead to getting stuck in the bathroom if you’re staying alone). One of the two bathrooms has a broken radiator, and there is visible mold in the shower cabin and under the wallpaper. It’s obvious that the mold has been developing for months, and no effort has been made to address it.
Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this place for a long-term stay, but it might be okay for a short stay of 2-3 days.

No Ac and they tried to fix it many times but no success and the weather was over 75 degree
One of the bathrooms is not working so five of us has to use only one bathroom
Not clean bedsheets and pillows

Overall a nice apartment, but only for maximum 4 guests (not up til 6 as advised on the listing).
We were 5 and the fifth person had to sleep on the coach which was were uncomfortable. There was also not even bed sheets, pillow, duvet or anything on the couch.
The kitchen was also lacking amenities, it has less than the bare minimum to be used. We had to buy everything our selves, just in order to cook and use dish washer etc. No soap, no towels in kitchen, cloth, taps for dishwasher, nothing.
Overall cannot recommend.

The apartment is in a good area, close to metro station and you get really fast at the city center. It is very spacious and can accommodate 4 people and a kid). It’s nice there are 2 bathrooms.
There should be some renovations needed (the walls, the bathroom), but maybe they will fix them in time.
The host is friendly. The location is quite.

our stay at dream houses was really good. we felt like home . lots of food and restaurants at walking distance. the owner is friendly, helpful, and responsive . he helped us with a few things around, which meant a lot to us. overall, we do recommend staying with them, especially with kids.

description: Casa Blanca is designed for a peaceful stay with a comfortable and minimal design, 30 m2 of indoor space and a 12 m2 patio. At Casa Blanca, you can spend the unique experience of Büyükada in your home like an islander!

reviews.text: Ev sahiplerinin iletişimi çok iyiydi. Öncesinde ve adaya vardığımızda yardımcı oldular. Ev fotoğraftakinin aynısıydı diyebilirim. Göründüğünden farklı olan: birçok eşya epey eskimişti. Bence evin ufak tadilatlara ve bakıma ihtiyacı var. Yatak ve çarşaflar çok temizdi. Yerler ve terasın genel temizliği pek iyi değildi ama yine de idare eder, çok titiz değilseniz kötü hissettirecek bir durumu yok. Biz keyifli bir gün geçirdik. Konumu çok iyiydi.

Büyükadada konakladığım Kardelen Hanım'ın evi, sadece temizlik ve şık dizayn açısından değil, aynı zamanda özenle düşünülmüş detaylarıyla da beni etkiledi. Evin her köşesi, misafirleri düşünerek tasarlanmış ve rahat bir atmosfer sunuyor. Temizlik standartları yüksek, her detay titizlikle temizlenmiş.
Dışarıdan içeriye adım attığınızda sizi sıcak bir atmosfer karşılıyor. Evin düzenlemesi, estetik seçimleri ve konforu, gerçekten konaklamayı keyifli kılıyor. Kardelen Hanım, sadece bir ev sahibi değil, aynı zamanda misafirperverliği ve iletişim becerileriyle de öne çıkıyor. İhtiyaç duyduğum her an yanımda oldu ve sorularıma hızlı ve yardımcı cevaplar verdi.
Büyükada'da sakin bir kaçamak yapmak isteyen herkese Kardelen Hanım'ın evini gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim. Burada geçireceğiniz zaman, hem adanın güzelliklerini keşfetmek hem de evin sıcaklığında huzurlu bir konaklama geçirmek için harika bir fırsat sunuyor.

Her şey için teşekkür ederiz. Ev sahipleriyle çok rahat ve sağlıklı iletişim kurulabiliyor. Ev göründüğünden daha küçük fakat dekorasyon olarak keyifli ve temizdi. Konumu, merkeze mesafesi ve manzarası itibariyle çok güzeldi. Zarif ikramlar için de ayrıca teşekkür ederiz.
Yatak odasının arkasındaki yaya yolu ve bahçelik alandaki yatağa çok yakın gürültüler dolayısıyla iki gece de pek rahat uyuyamadık. Ayrıca yan komşular da kalabalık bir aile sanırım. Bitmeyen çocuk ağlamaları eşlik etti konaklamamıza :) Fakat total olarak pozitif bir deneyimdi.

Place is nice for a couple of days
It’s modern and stylish, but a little bit dusty and smaller than in the pictures
Location is quite, around 10-15 mins by walk to the nearest restaurants and shops
Hosts are very nice and communicative!

4 arkadaş güzel bir haftasonu geçirmek için airbnb’deki evlere bakarken bu evi bulduk. Açıkçası evet fotoğraflar birebir aynı. Çok şık dekore edilen bir ev olduğunu düşünerek evi tuttuk. Fakat ev aslında el emeği göz nuru bir şekilde boyanarak güzelleştirilen, genel olarak tekrar boyanması gereken, temizliğe daha özen gösterilmesi gereken bir ev. Yorganlar ve koltuk kesinlikle yıkanmalı, banyo ve mutfak tezgahı tekrar boyanmalı. Çünkü verdiğimiz bu fiyata kahvaltının da dahil olduğu oteller olduğunu gördük. Evin ısıtması gayet iyiydi, sıcak su vardı. Buzdolabına bizim için su bırakılmış, banyoda kişisel bakım ürünleri, kağıt havlu ve tuvalet kağıdı, temiz havlu ve terlik vardı. Bunlardan dolayı memnun kaldık 👍 teşekkür ederiz

description:
You can experience the soul of Cihangir in this quite and central located apartment.

-Features of the flat-
-On foot;

5 mins. to Taksim square,
10min. Karakoy and Galata Port,
2 mins. to the most fun streets of Cihangir.

Terms of Use:

Your kitchen and bathroom needs (including kitchen utensils, clean linens and towels) will be provided by us.

Our flat is on the ground floor.

reviews.text:
Best experience in Istanbul!
Everything was just perfect!
Apartment is super brand new, stylish and fully furnished! It’s really cosy to stay and enjoy.
Unbelievable clean and comfortable!
Location is perfect, it’s quite, but just 1-2 mins by walk to cafes, bars, groceries and etc.
Hosts are very friendly, responsible and helpful! We haven’t had no problems at all!
Thank you very much for your experience!
Will come back with pleasure 😌
The apartment was very clean and modern like in photos and the couch and bed very cozy. Also the host was very friendly and understanding. Would recommend without precaution

Beautiful place, great wifi, walkable neighborhood. less than 10 min to Taksim square, the T1 line, the funicular. There are many restaurants, grocery stores, coffee shops within 5 min walk...or less. The hosts were very nice and responsive. I definitely recommend this place.
Very confortable apartment, very clean. The hosts are very friendly and lovely. Location is perfect, I’d definitely come back.

this has been the sweetest place we have stayed in Istanbul so far. the flat is newly renovated and well equipped. the location is the best you can ask for, just behind all that cihangir offers, but on a quite corner. the wifi is great and IIker is very approachable and flexible.

description:
From our house, which is centrally located in Üsküdar, Istanbul, you can walk to Marmaray in 10 minutes, the ferry pier in 12 minutes, the Kadıköy minibus stop in 4 minutes and the bus stops in 5 minutes.
There are also markets and grocery stores, restaurants and shops near the house.
The Maiden's Tower, a world-famous tourist attraction, is also within walking distance of our house.

reviews.text: If I want to explain this property in one word, I would say: exceptional! The location is great having the ferry boat station and metro station in the walking distance. From the entrance to the apartment, there are only few stairs, making it easy to bring in luggages. The apartment itself is amazingly bright with a very comfortable, cozy and nice design. It was also exceptionally clean with hotel liked beddings and towels. On top, there was a very thoughtful welcome goodies (fruits and a bottle of wine). Last but not least, the host was very supportive to accept a late check out. I totally can recommend this place to families as well as young couples and solo travelers.

Ișil was an amazing host! She was always responsive and helpful. The apartment was beautiful, clean and had all the necessities required to stay comfortably. The beds were very comfortable and clean as was the bathroom. The apartment was perfectly located. The only thing that the apartment didn’t have was air conditioning which was challenging at times as it was super hot but there were fans available so it was manageable. I definitely recommend staying here if you are looking for an apartment to rent.

Our family stayed 5 nights in this excellent home in Istanbul. It was super clean, pretty and aesthetic, and the location is very convenient: just a short walk from Üsküdar metro and ferry. There are also lots of cafés, restaurants and masjids nearby which is lovely! Işıl was the best host- she was always quick to respond to any questions and very helpful. She left all the necessary amenities plus extras like fruit, water and juice. Işıl even arranged a taxi back to the airport for us which was amazing :) Highly recommended, thank you so much Işıl!

The place was exactly as described, spotless, walking distance from metro and bus, great places to dine and shop around..isil was very responsive and helpful. she welcome us with a nice bottle of wine and grappes..Uskudar is a beautiful district and less crowded with tourists..we felt at home ..a must flat to stay if you plan to visit the Asian side..

Hands down this is the cleanest holiday apartment we've ever stayed in-& cleaner than a hotel, for sure. The linen and towels were crisps, no dirt on the floors (we always bring a speedmop with us as we have a little boy who crawls around the floor) when we wiped the floor it was spotless. There were pretty little touches all around the flat too to make it seem like home, including a lovely welcome gift.
The most touching part is that we had an emergency and I had to contact Isil at an unsociable hour for help. She responded quickly with great compassion and help and then checked to make sure everything was ok. Isil really seems to care for her guests and to make sure they have a great stay, and we did. We were so relaxed and couldn't have asked for more from her.
We had a buggy, and the location is great (10 minutes walk uskudar ferry) but the road is very steep leading from the main road which would be difficult for somebody disabled. but taxis easily navigate it in this case

description:
Our house is 160 m2 and is spacious, large and comfortable. Natural gas, wifi, kitchen utensils, coffee and toasters are available and it is suitable for 8 people to stay. You can use the apartment's own parking lot. There is a 24/7 janitor in our building and you can place your grocery orders.
Our house is 160 m2 and comfortably spacious. Natural gas, wifi, kitchen utensils, coffee & toast machines are available and suitable for up to 8 people. You can use the parking space. There is a 24/7 apartment attendant.

Hersey anlatıldığıgi ibi gayet temiz ve hijyenik ortam bütün malzemeler tam merkezi konumda bütün olanaklar mevcut Bora bey ilgili ve nazik bir ev sahibi teşekkürler hersey için mutlaka tavsiye edilebilir....

description: Our apartments are distinguished by the spacious area suitable for family residence, as it contains all the necessary necessities for a comfortable and happy stay, where you feel as if you are in your own home. We also have a 24/24 reception desk to secure the needs of guests at any time, and the entire building contains a security system and cameras that work around the clock In addition to the availability of the Internet throughout the hotel, also the apartments have amazing city view

reviews.text: The location is good. The reception people are very cooperative and helpful. However, the apartment is dirty in general. The master bedroom lights were not working. The kitchen was empty, except couple of knifes and very dirty water heater. I cannot come to this place again.

Great communication before hand, place looked exactly as described, we booked the flat to host my elderly grandparents from abroad, to celebrate my birthday, they had to climb only 4 steps to get in the reception and rest had lift to take us to 7th floor, exactly as they promised.
The flat itself is spacious and tidy like in the pictures.
View and sunset from 7th floor is stunning. Staff are very nice and helpful and always available in reception.
My grandma got stuck inside the bathroom one night as the lock was extremely stiff/broken. It was after midnight but they sent someone with the drill to open it as soon as we asked them (thank you)
the only thing was lacking was basic utilities such as washing up liquid, tea pot, good cooking knife and cooking pan etc… we had to buy everything for few days stay and left them all there.
Rest of the things were great and we are very thankful my grandparents had a very comfortable, quiet and sweet stay with us.

An incredibly spacious suite of rooms and the ability to check in anytime. Hexa Suites is more like a hotel. It’s in a very nice, walkable area and is close to tons of restaurants and shops. There is a paid parking lot nearby.

it's like an apartment with reception and lobby the location was good, the surrounding are alive and full of shops, the view from 7th floor was nice and the living room was big and they provide us parking spot other wise it'll be a problem .. there was dust on the floors and one bathroom with shower and one without so it's hard in the morning for 6 ppl to shower to go out in the morning
overall i didn't regret to stay there, and if you have even an infant they'll calculate it as a person and you'll pay for it

Our group had a very nice stay at the apartment. The personnel works 24/4, everyone was very friendly and responsive - they helped us with additional bedsheets and towels, printed out the documents for us, and arranged a transfer to the airport at a reasonable price. The apartment was equipped with all necessary things and was quite clean. We enjoyed our stay.

description: The room close to Kadıköy, metro and metrobüs 5 minutes by walk, Free wifi, refrigerator, washing machine and kitchen for cooking is included. Before reservation please ask for availability!

reviews.text:
Erol’s friendly and welcoming. the place didn’t match the pics I saw on Airbnb. The bed was smaller than the one on the pics and the whole room was super dusty, plus no way to lock the door (can’t walk around knowing my things aren’t totally safe)
I think you can find much better deals for the same price. The only great thing was the location.
It was comfortable staying. The location is good. Kitchen, Landry machine etc.. everything that you need to stay is ready. He can speak English well.

Erol is a knowledgeable, helpful, and attentive good host. The place itself is comfortable and easily reached by local transportation. There are cafes and restos nearby. It's a convenient place to be.
Nice location in a quiet neighbourhood with a good access to transportation, shops and restaurants. The host helped me with some issues and was easy to communicate with.

Nice area close to the splendid Müze Gazhane. I liked the room a lot, though it might not be to everyone's tastes, being placed slightly below surface level. I liked the furniture. Kitchen was not exemplary, but good enough and I got used to it.

description:
Stay in the heart of Galata, one of Istanbul's most historic and vibrant neighborhoods. Hosted by Homie Suites, this stylish one-bedroom apartment combines modern comfort with the character of old Istanbul.

Located on the quiet Serasker Çıkmazı, just steps from Serdar-ı Ekrem Street, Galata Tower, and Karaköy, you'll be perfectly positioned to explore the city's cafés, restaurants, boutiques, and cultural landmarks

reviews.text:
+
The best location in Istanbul for tourism.
Warm and clean apartment with fast Wi-fi and fully equipped kitchen. Very comfortable bed and pillows. Superhost. Easy check in.
+-
The shower cabin is leaking during taking shower.
It was impossible to fully close the window in the sleeping room.
There is unpleasant sewerage smell from closed terrace in the living room and inside of terrace.

One of the best hosts I have experienced at an Airbnb so far. The check in was easy and the communication with Gizem was perfect. Her description of the place was spot on. It was a beautiful apartment and was very spacious with an indoor veranda which was really cool. The location was simply perfect. It was situated in a lovely neighbourhood that was both peaceful and convenient with plenty of shops and restaurants and attractions at a short distance away. Plus the public transportation options were plentiful and easy to navigate, making it simple to explore all the city had to offer.
Gizem was very kind and helpful host who made us feel at home. She went above and beyond her role. What made the Airbnb stand out was the host hospitality and attention to detail.
As for the space itself I was blown away with how stylish, clean , new and comfortable and well equipped the place was.
I highly recommend you to stay in this place.
Super 10/10

Fantastic location for access to the main tourist sites - without actually being in the middle of it all. This apartment is tucked away on a quiet street in Galata, so it feels quite private. Yet you can get to the main pedestrian street and public transportation (metro and tram) in just 5 minutes. The neighborhood has a great vibe with lots of cafes and funky vintage shops nearby. Gizem is a lovely host, and even kindly allowed us to leave our bags in the apartment early in the day of our arrival. She was quick to respond when we had a problem with the shower, and repairs were made within a few hours. The apartment was perfect for our needs, including a comfortable bed, good wifi, and a quiet environment to rest at the end of the day. I highly recommend this place and would definitely book it again.

We had the best stay in Istanbul, Gizem made us feel so welcome before we'd even arrived and has been such a lovely host. The location of the apartment is perfect, just a few minutes walk from the stunning Galata Tower, loads of delicious restaurants and coffee shops nearby. We walked over the bridge to see the big three mosques (about half an hour) and the bazar. There is also the ferry ports in Kabatas and Eminonu for trips out to the Princess Islands/Karikoy. I would recommend the place to anyone visiting. The pictures do not do the apartment justice, the living room is beautiful, and the enclosed balcony looks into a lovely courtyard. The kitchen is well supplied in terms of cooking equipment, tea and coffee, and they left lovely toiletries. Thank you so much Gizem!

This is such a cute apartment but it is on top of a hill and difficult for cars to enter and park, this could be an accessibility issue. It is about 10 minutes walk to Tophane tram in Beyoglu.
Internet speed is ok in the living room but not very fast in the bedroom.
Very unique stay and comfortable with excellent bedding and sheets, attentive staff, easy check-in…

reviews.text:
We stayed at Eren’s place with our family for 10 days, and overall, we had a good experience.
The building is nice, with 24/7 security and service available. Whenever we needed something, Amjad was always willing to help and was very responsive.
The location is excellent—very close to Taksim and Istiklal Street, with plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, and other shops nearby. The street felt safe, and there was a strong local presence in the area. Most of the buildings around are small hotels and tourist apartments.
Our first impression was a little strange because it is an older area, and the street might look a little dirty at first. However, this is natural for the character of the location, and after the first day, we became much more comfortable and enjoyed the area.
Overall, Eren and his staff were very helpful, friendly, and responsive to our requests. We appreciate their hospitality and would be happy to stay there again.

We had a wonderful stay at Eren’s place in Istanbul! The location is excellent — just a short walk to Taksim, which made it easy to explore the city. The rooms were very clean and comfortable, and Eren was incredibly helpful throughout our stay. He was always available and made sure we had everything we needed. We really enjoyed our time here

The flat was very clean, tidy, and exactly as described. Eren Yusuf was friendly, welcoming, and always helpful. The service was excellent from check-in to check-out, and the whole stay was smooth and enjoyable. They made our trip a wonderful experience, and we have very happy memories of our stay. Thank you, Mr. Yusuf, for your great hospitality. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend this place to others.

Eren Yusuf was extremely responsive and kind, always ready to offer his help to us. It is walking distance to Taksim and we had no worries going back to the apartment late at night. Though quiet, the street was sufficiently lit. We were a big group of girls and we felt safe and comfortable during our 3 nights stay. Would definitely reccommend this place, especially if you are travelling as a big group.
Had a wonderful stay in Istanbul! The accommodation was very clean and comfortable. The host was kind, welcoming, and always helpful. Highly recommend for anyone visiting this beautiful city!

description:
Experience the unique Bosphorus view in Moda, the heart of Istanbul. Stay with your loved ones in our centrally located house with its modern architecture and stylish design. Our house promises its guests a pleasant time with its proximity to entertainment centers, culinary and historical spots and all transportation lines.

In addition to all the amenities that should be available in a house, we also have cleaning staff at your service whenever you wish.

reviews.text:
Amazing apartment, I really enjoyed my stay! It’s the first time the apartments looks better in real life than on photos!
The location is perfect, the view from the window is just amazing. The check in was very easy, smart lock is very convenient.
Bed in master bedroom is top notch!
I am giving 5 stars to this place with no doubts, although I would love If host paid a little bit more attention to some details: 1) Overall, apartment is very clean, although floor was a little bit sticky in some places, there is some mold near the kitchen window (not a lot but still); 2) The apartment is gorgeous, you can see it has expensive furniture and overall it feels elite, but in little details it lacks maintenance and finesse (baseboards are coming off in few places; lights in both bathrooms are very dimmed and it’s basically impossible to shave); 3) for such price, having something basic like shower gels/shampoos in bath salt/sugar in the kitchen would be really nice
I recommend it anyway!

The house is beautiful, like from Pinterest. Check-in was the most convenient we've had this year. Inside, everything is very clean. The location of the house is perfect - right in the center of Moda, but quiet. The kitchen is convenient. There are absolutely no supplies provided: soap, shampoo, salt, laundry detergent, slippers (the floors are cold), tea, sponge etc. There are only towels, toilet paper and that's it. There are no thresholds anywhere in the house or outside. In the first shower, the water doesn't drain, it leaked into the room. In the second shower, the glass door that closes the shower is off its hinges and standing inside. Water leaks onto the floor of the bathroom and bedroom. The internet is so slow that it barely suffices to open the messengers. Speedtest currently shows 265-500 kbps. host responds 4-6 hours after the question is asked. And one of the rooms has no upper light. But it’s really good looking house.

When we first entered the apartment it looked just like the photos and the view was really great. However we soon noticed a strong smell of cigarettes (there was even a packet of cigarettes on one of the shelves in the kitchen)- the smell was really overwhelming and suffocating. We even felt that our clothes began to smell of cigarettes after three days in the apartment. We also noticed that the glass shower door was broken and resting precariously against the wall.
Also, on the first evening the apartment above from the same air bnb hosts was having a party. We tried to ask them to be quiet but they refused to open the door and just continued shouting and turned up the music. We contacted the host and they said they would speak with them. Unfortunately it didn't do much to stop the noise and we had a very sleepless night the first night. Overall we felt that the hosts were not very sympathetic and didnt offer any kind of solution for the cigarette smoke or the partying neighbours.

Staff was very friendly and super helpful. Apartment it is spacious and comfortable, exactly like in the photos. The bathroom lighting it is an issue though - very dark and you can't see much inside. Location is good but the street feels unsafe at night. Note: the building has an unusual entrance. You need to pass by an automatic rolling door first and then the main door. It feels like entering a commercial warehouse everytime.

First of all, we were pleased with the location being close to everywhere but in a quiet area. Since it was not a very busy street, we had no problems loading and unloading. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Communication with the landlord was easy.

description: Located in Kadıköy, Historic Yeldeğirmeni area, close to all means of public transportation available with a great istanbul bosphorus view with a huge terrace.

reviews.text: Really nice stay in Deniz's place. I enjoyed my stay with Deniz and his lovely cat. From the beginning, clear instructions and he is excellent at communication. He welcomed me in his place and kindly explained everything when I just checked in. Prepared everything for the guest and even he will send you the presentation that has all the information you need. You can also ask anything to him and he will kindly answer all the questions. He also invited me to go out for dinner with him and his friend on my arrival very kind of him. There is a filtered water tab in the kitchen, which is nice. Having my own bathroom and upstairs and balcony for myself was also great. The balcony view is beautiful as he described, you can enjoy the sea breeze from the balcony and I enjoyed the view every morning for the sunrise and sunset time. his cat is so sweet as well. The place is located in a quiet local area and walkable to anywhere. I would highly recommend to stay in his place

It was great having a private floor and private bathroom. the view from the terrace was amazing. The area is filled with locals and very authentic. The apartment was close to the ferry dock and shuttle bus that goes to the airport. Deniz was kind when the temperature was colder than expected he turned on the heat. One thing to consider: while you will not smell any cigarette smoke in your upstairs space, the downstairs does smell smoky. The listing says that smoking is only in the kitchen and the terrace, but the kitchen is in the same room as the living room. Deniz does not smoke a lot, but he does sometimes. So if you are very sensitive to cigarette smoke and you think you’ll need to be in the kitchen or living room this may not be the place for you. if you plan to just come and go and stay in your loft area, then by all means stay here. Bring an eye mask if you don’t like light in the morning. No shade on skylight.

I had a wonderful stay here and would highly recommend it! The apartment is newly renovated, spotlessly clean, and is in a central location - only a few minutes' walk to the vibrant Kadikoy eating precinct, and a 5-10 minute walk to Kadikoy pier where you can catch a quick ferry over to the European side of the city. The guest bedroom and bathroom are on the second floor, which allows for maximum privacy. There is also a balcony on the second floor which has gorgeous views over the Bosphorous. But best of all are the host, Deniz, and his cat Puffy. Deniz was such a kind and generous host and seriously went out of his way to help/guide me, but he also respected my privacy - it was a great pleasure to stay with him. And as for Puffy, she is definitely a dog in a cat's body - one of the friendliest, most gentle cats I've ever met! She was adorable company and I'm now hatching plans to steal her...
Thank you for everything Deniz and Puffy - I really hope to visit you again in the future!

When i first stumbled upon this flat on AirBnB, it seemed almost too good to be true. There must be a catch! But everything was as perfect as it seemed online. deniz is the most thoughtful, gracious host.
He provided me with all the information i needed and shared with me all places an tips. The flat is just perfect! Kitchen is compact and contains everything one needs.
I can’t stop thinking about his cate she’s very friendly with guests .
The bed is comfortable, bathroom and terrace are excellent. Location is incredible.
Thank you deniz

This has been my best stay ever! Deniz's place is newly renovated, tastefully decorated with a great kitchen. He is super a helpful and very attentive host. He made me feel right at home. He had great suggestions for places in the neighborhood and getting around Istanbul. I loved having the upstairs to myself with a private bathroom and rain shower. Even the towels and soap were amazing! The view from the balcony is unforgettable. This is my favorite area in Istanbul. I felt so lucky to stay here. I didn't want to leave :)

description:
For your trips with your family or friends upto 6 people, beautiful modern apartment completely renovated at the city center, close to bus stop, metro, major roads, shops, cafes, restaurants.
This consists of: an entrance hall designed as a fully equipped kitchen, a living room,2 bedrooms with double beds, 1 bedroom with 2 single beds,2 bathroom with walk-in shower, washer, tv.

reviews.text:
Cozy apartment near the metro station within walking distance from ships and restaurants.
Quiet and warm with no noise from the streets and the air conditioning works well... Strong internet and cozy furniture... There is a balcony off the main bedroom and an elevator in the building.
The beds are very uncomfortable and all you feel is Springs on each part of your body. Should be replaced or at least a mattress topper added... The pillows are not the best and the shower leaks all over the bathroom floor. The dining room is spacious and cozy and the smart TV is awesome.
The kitchen is very tiny and there is no space to properly cook your meals, there needs to be additional table to make is more feasible... The kitchen needs more items for guests to use to cook with as there are a lot of things missing.
The host replys but sometimes it takes a while. Very helpful and friendly and they meet you at the apartment with the keys.
Be sure to ask for extra keys and to have balcony unlocked

Dusty and not clean apartment. Beds were broken and very uncomfortable, springs from the mattress were broken and hurting our backs. There was a bad smell in the apartment. There was no batteries for the AC remote control (there was only 1 remote control for the whole apartment). We kept changing the batteries from the TV remote control and the AC Remote control.
Great host and location as well

The place is very wonderful as a location. All services are available around you. Getting in and out is very easy. Housing is very warm in winter. Mr. Amir, The employee, is a very cooperative, respected. The only annoying thing is the windows isolation needs to be fixed. But yes, I recommend the place again and I'll definitely be back.
Perfect place , perfect Location

description:

reviews.text:
I had a very pleasant stay at this suite in Istanbul. The booking process was very fast and smooth, and the team was very helpful and cooperative from the beginning.✨
The location is excellent and very strategic. The transportation station is nearby, Galataport is very close, and Taksim is also easily accessible. The building is beautiful, safe, and well located.🌷
A special thank you to the entire team. Everyone was extremely kind, respectful, friendly, and helpful. I truly appreciate their support and kindness during my stay, and I will not forget how they treated me.🌷🌷🫶🏻
The suite was spacious, clean, and comfortable, and the services were good overall. There are only a few small things that could be improved, such as some minor maintenance and better lighting above the mirror in the hallway.
Overall, I had a very good experience and would definitely recommend this place. I’m happy to give it a high rating, and I would gladly stay here again whenever I visit Istanbul.🫰🏻💗

The two guys at the reception we’re very nice and friendly. The accommodation is perfectly located in the middle of the European side and tophane station is a 1 minute walk away.
However because of the central location it’s very loud at night and you can hear everything happening at the main road from noisy cats to cars with loud music playing at 3am.
The room was very spacious but overall it needs to be cleaned better especially the bathroom should be renovated. There were stains on the wall and ground near the bed and a lot of stains across the bathroom walls. The sanitary equipment wasn’t the newest and cleanest.
Regarding the price payed it was ok especially because of the great location but the accommodation could be much better if it would be renovated and cleaned.

Erhan's place was good. The location is excellent and the room has all you need for a short stay. It's more of a hotel type than a regular Airbnb. The pictures are nicer than the actual room due to the quality of finishes and materials used in the renovation. All in all the price, location, 24hr reception are worth it.
Incredible location, lovely bedroom. The bathroom was ok, the shower didn’t really get warm. But overall, it was a very easy check in and we felt very secure. Would stay again.

This apartment is clean and lovely. And the bed is enough bigger than other hotel for two people.
but It's a little far from Tacksim station and an entertainment street.
but the landlord and housekeeper are sooo kind :) so im satisfied with this appartment 😊

reviews.text:
Stayed for 11 days. Excellent location of the hotel. The room was on the first floor. Everything was clean. The description of the apartments was accurate. The owner and staff are friendly. Communication was prompt. The bed is very comfortable. Great price. Washing machines and ironing board are on the -1st floor. The apartments were comfortable and a pleasure to stay in.
Some of the disadvantages. When I arrived at the hotel for the first time, I couldn't enter the hotel itself because at the entrance there was an electronic access by number. Ask for your password upon arrival. In some moments there was no hot water in the shower. There was occasional noise from people talking outside the window. Sometimes the call to prayer could be heard from a nearby mosque when the windows were open. If you close the windows, you won't hear any outside noise.
I can give 4.5 out of 5. I can recommend these apartments, even with some of the disadvantages I described above.

Impeccably clean and perfectly situated, this Airbnb gem offers a seamless blend of tranquility and proximity to Istanbul's vibrant local cafes and eateries. Nestled in the heart of Cihangir, this oasis of calm remains undisturbed even in close proximity to the area's main attractions. While my stay was nearly flawless, the only blip was the unwelcome presence of some lively travelers in an adjacent room. While I understand this is beyond the owners' control, a gentle suggestion to patrons to keep the midnight merriment in check could be considered. A couple of unexpected leaps from the bed aside, provoked by mirthful commotion next door and upstairs, my experience was top-notch. I eagerly anticipate revisiting this spotless haven in the future.
It's a great location and the accommodation is nice and clean, everything as described. Host very kind. I had a very nice stay! I would definitely come back next time I'm in Istanbul

Located in stunning Çukur Cuma area with few minute walk to Bosphorus and ferry station makes this place great choice for all visitors in Istanbul. It was very clean, quiet and exactly as described. Thank you!

This is my second time staying with them. The location is amazing, close to all central places and metro.
The place is very clean, tidy and quiet. There is free wifi and quality TV in the room.
The host is very friendly and helpful for anything.
I will definitely stay again when I visit Istanbul.

reviews.text:
We had a nice stay at this apartment, and we truly appreciate the host’s kindness and responsiveness. The place was clean and well-maintained, and we loved having access to the sauna, pool, and gym, which we used almost every day – definitely a great perk!
That said, there was a persistent odor in the apartment, and despite the host promptly sending a cleaning crew, it remained noticeable throughout our stay. We also chose this location for its convenience, with two restaurants downstairs and a mini-market right across the street, which made things very easy. However, the noise level was quite high at all hours, which made it difficult to fully relax.
Overall, a good stay with great amenities and a helpful host, but something to keep in mind if you’re sensitive to noise. Thank you again for hosting us!

We had a very enjoyable stay at this apartment. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and matched the description in the listing. It had everything we needed for a pleasant stay, and we felt at home from the moment we arrived.
One thing we especially appreciated was the host's communication. Whenever we had a question, the host responded very quickly and was always helpful, which made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. Check-in was simple, and the instructions were clear and easy to follow.
The apartment was also conveniently located with easy access to bus transportation, making it simple to get around the city

This is our second stay with the same host, just in a different unit and the experience was overall just as good! The apartment was complete, comfortable, and well-equipped, perfect for our family.
As always, the host was responsive and helpful, which we really appreciated throughout our time in Istanbul.
Just a few small things to note: we found a plate with a cracked edge, which could be risky when washing manually. Also, the iron and carpet could be cleaned more thoroughly to match the overall cleanliness of the rest of the apartment.
But overall, the place was still very nice, and we would definitely recommend it to other guests looking for a modern, spacious stay in the city.

It was really a nice place to stay at, walking distance to good spots and the host was amazing they were responsive and helped in making us get an early check in due to our early flight. Overall i would recommend anyone to stay here. Thank you Hajer for your great communication❤️❤️❤️

Fantastic stay from start to finish! The host was incredibly communicative — responsive, helpful, and made check-in a breeze. The space itself was beautifully designed with a sleek, modern aesthetic that felt fresh and upscale. Exactly what you hope for when booking. Highly recommend!

description: The apartment is just 5 minutes walking away from the Grand Bazaar and 15 minutes walking away from the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. The area is safe and full of hotels. Walking distance to nightlife, restaurants and other attractions. Our place is suitable for couples, solo adventurers, corporate travelers, families (children). Free WiFi, TV, Hair Dryer, Kettle, Non-smoking Room, Central Heating System, 24-Hours Hot Water.

reviews.text: There were some issues, no hot plate but was delivered when we asked for it. The floors were dirty, the bed linen was stained and the towels were stained. The place was much smaller than the pictures. It was cold and the wind did blow throw the closed windows. We needed new batteries for the air conditioner to warm the place up, which were delivered promptly when we asked. There was a day with no hot water, that did get corrected when we sent our concern. The sounds from the next apartment was as if the was no wall. WIFi was spotty. The stair case going up 4 floors was a bit unsafe with no hand rail and very steep curves. Not easy to get luggage up. The location was great with an awesome restaurant across the street. Our concerns were addressed quickly. The place needs some TLC

The apartment was perfect, I highly recommend it to everyone. We arrived earlier, and our host was kind enough to store our luggage and we could also check in earlier. The room was super cozy, clean and comfortable. It was located literally 5-10 mins from shops, restaurants, tram and the Grand Bazaar. We couldn’t have picked a better apartment!

We stayed here for 2 nights. Communication online was very smooth, yet we had to use googletranslate with the person who actually let us in. The place is within walking distance from everything, so we were very happy with the location. (Even though it can get a but noise at night because of it.)
The place is quite small but has what you need, and it is clean and tidy.
So it was a nice stay after all. Thank you!
Lovely, cozy place in a lively area. Everything was exactly as described. Amazing value for money. The host was very kind and friendly and helped us with late check-in.

Place was clean and comfortable. Place is near restaurants and not so far from the tram station
100% would come back

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Nice friendly host, clean bedroom, old kitchen. Neighbours downstairs are listening to music almost every evening and night, after 12 a.m too. It is not host's fault, but I asked her previously if it is noisy. So I need to inform others: if you dont like the noise then this flat is not your option.

One of the best stays I have ever had. Yesim is kind and caring, and her place is clean and in a fantastic location. It's away from the super expensive tourist places while still being close to lots of nice cafes and restaurants that locals go to. The people in the neighborhood were friendly and once I got to know some of them they were very kind and helpful. Becoming a "local" was an added bonus!
If you like less touristy, more authentic areas where you can see the real Istanbul without being far from the center, go with this place! I'll be coming back!
Also, the best baklava I've ever had was just a five minute walk 😍
Nice and spacious. Great location. Good value for money. Yesim, the host, is very responsive and friendly. Highly recommended.

The location was in a good spot. Close to Metro . The apartment was surrounded by markets and restaurants.
The house is the same as in pictures. The host is very kind and easygoing person.

I had a great stay in the apartment. It was spacious, calm and comfortable. The neighborhood is mostly residential but there are still some great restaurants around and it remains really well connected thanks to the close by metro.
Thank you!

description: Welcome to our cozy retreat in Istanbul's center! It offers comfort and convenience in a friendly neighborhood. Relax in our stylish space with a private garden. Walk to the best coffee shops, restaurants, and the sea in minutes. Easy access to public transportation makes exploring the city a breeze. Discover Maçka Park and Nişantaşı within walking distance. Experience Istanbul's vibrant atmosphere while enjoying our warm hospitality. Book now for an unforgettable stay in the heart of Istanbul!

reviews.text:
As a local, I can say that the location was great for many nice cafes and restaurants around. Highly recommend if you want to avoid touristic areas and have more local experience.
Check in was very smooth and they made the process easy for us for both check in and check out.
House is equipped with many amenities that you may need for a short stay.
If we need to mention one « bad »thing , the house is darker than it looks on the photos.
Overall , it was a very nice stay and we recommend .

Amazing quiet apartment, located closely to many cafes and several supermarkets. Very spacious living room with great collection of books and vinyl record player, making it especially cosy) Lots of storage space and bright kitchen with everything needed for cooking. Good WiFi. Many thanks to the host - all communications were swift and easy. Highly recommended

I stayed in Hande’s apartment for over a month and I loved it. I would definitely stay there again. Wonderful location, host and apartment. Everything is as advertised in the listing and the location is close to restaurants, coffee shops and everything you need for a long term stay.
It was a perfect stay! The location is quite good and the house was pretty cozy and clean. Thanks.

Hande‘s apartment is really comfortable and cosy. It’s only 2 minutes by foot from the center of Besiktas but it’s quiet at night. We had a really good time and would definitely rent this room again! :)

description:
Beautiful and comfortable apartment in the heart of Istanbul, perfect for families or small groups.

🏡 Two bedrooms
🛋️ Spacious living room
🍳 Fully equipped kitchen with natural gas stove
🧺 Washing machine & refrigerator

📍 Amazing central location
* 2 min walk to Galata Tower
* 4 min walk to Galataport
* 3 min walk to Tophane tram station
*5 min walk to Karaköy

Cafés, markets and metro are all nearby.
We would be happy to host you in our apartment 😊

Best regards,
Şaban

reviews.text:
The flat is on the second floor. It looks nice, is exactly as on the photos, clean and has almost all amenities which we needed. I would expect few more dishes, few bowls, a couple more spoons and forks. Also a small wardrobe or a couple of shelves would make the small bedroom more comfortable.
The flat is located near Galata tower, but not in noisy touristic area - just about 3-5 min walking to souvenir shops etc :) Very nice cafes, a couple of small shops with fruits/water/etc. just in few steps, as well as ceramics galleries and couple of fancy clothes shops. It is also very well connected to main tourist attractions by tram.
Be careful, if some of the visitors is not sporty enough - the flat is located in a very hilly area with steep terrain, and it could be a problem for people with some mobility problems to go downhill to the tram and uphill- back to the apartment.
We are very thankful to Şaban for possibility of earlier check-in! He was all the time responsive and helpful!

From the moment we arrived, everything felt just right. The location is absolutely fantastic within walking distance to public transport, shops, and many of Istanbul’s main attractions, making it incredibly convenient.
The apartment is perfect for families. It’s spacious, comfortable, and very well arranged. You can clearly see that every detail has been carefully prepared to ensure a pleasant stay.
Everything matched the photos perfectly, which made us feel confident and relaxed from the beginning.
Although there is no elevator in the building, the host was extremely helpful during check-in and kindly assisted us with carrying our luggage, which we truly appreciated.
The host was very kind, responsive, and always ready to help whenever needed.
A great choice for anyone looking for a well-located and family-friendly place. Definitely recommended!thank you guys

The location of this apartment was incredible, with easy walking access to the Karakoy port, Galata tower, Metro and Bus and numerous restaurants, and cafés. The place also has a rooftop with a lovely view of the Bosphorus, which was a delightful bonus. The host, Şaban, was very responsive, cooperative, and even arranged a transfer from the airport at a fair price. We could also check in earlier, which was very convenient. However, the apartment was not well-equipped with kitchen essentials; there were not enough plates, pots, pans, or cutlery, and the iron was old and unreliable. Additionally, while the bathroom was clean, it didn't meet our expectations for cleanliness. Another downside was that there was no air conditioner in all the rooms. Only in the living room. Overall, the experience was mixed, more with good points.

The host was friendly and supportive, he even given me extra hours to pack and stay till my flight time, the apartment was clean, the location was amazing as it is in the middle of everything and 3 minutes away from Galata, 5 minutes away from Istiklal st close to Metro stations, tramp, ferry, beach Eminono.
little bit hot in the bed rooms but we managed that. there is an AC unit in the reception.

The location is amazing, Galata Tower is nearby, tram T1 and Galaport are 5 minutes away, metro is 7-10 minutes away.
There are many cafes, restaurants and shops nearby for every taste.
The apartments are clean, comfortable, there are two small bedrooms, a living room with a kitchen. The roof terrace has a beautiful view on the Bosphorus and the sunrise! We really liked the contactless access to the apartment.
All the necessary appliances are available - a refrigerator, stove, microwave. The hairdryer and washing machine are in the bathroom. Heating and hot water worked well.
The only thing we thought was lacking was electrical sockets near the beds, it's a little bit inconvenient to not have a place to charge the phones near the bed.
It was a really great experience nevertheless, would recommend!

description: Stay in the heart of Galata in this beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment on Kumbaracı Yokuşu. Newly furnished with modern appliances, it offers a stylish and quiet escape. The open living space features a beautiful view of a private interior garden, adding a serene touch. Just steps from Istiklal Street, top restaurants, and shops, this home blends comfort and convenience.

reviews.text: My family and I had an excellent stay! The check-in process was extremely easy, with flexible options and very responsive communication from the host. The apartment was spotlessly clean — from the furniture and linen to the pristine kitchen and squeaky-clean bathroom. Everything looked exactly like the photos and matched the listing description perfectly, with all listed amenities provided. The host was friendly, always responsive, and provided clear, helpful instructions throughout the stay. The location was also fantastic — very walkable, lots to do nearby and good restaurants. Note that Beyoglu can get a bit noisy, with motorbikes making deliveries up and down the neighborhood. Overall, a great deal for the price. Highly recommended!

We stayed for a week as a group of four and here’s our honest experience.
Pros: the location is excellent, very close to Galata and Istiklal Street, with lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance. Communication with the host was good and check-in was smooth. The building has an elevator, which is helpful for luggage, kids, or elderly guests.
Cons: the kitchen cookware was very basic, so if you plan to cook or stay longer, it’s not ideal. Several basic household items were missing, including a trash bin in the bathroom, paper towels, dishwasher soap and similar essentials. There were also no extra linens or blankets. We stayed in winter, and since there was no AC/heating in the bedrooms, the temperature wasn’t balanced , the living room was warm but the bedrooms were cold at night. Additionally, there was noticeable street noise during our stay, which affected sleep quality.
Overall, great location and helpful host, but better suited for short stays than longer ones.

The apartment is lovely and spacious. Everything was clean and nice. The location was perfect, with everything within walking distance. However, the street is VERY steep. There are many small, good restaurants nearby. It’s not far to Karaköy and Galataport. Galata Tower and the cozy little streets are also just around the corner.
We received fantastic service from Drew, who answered all our questions quickly. They bought food for the fridge since we arrived quite late — great service. They also quickly brought extra bedding and sharper knives.
We do, however, have a couple of tips… The lock on the main door is difficult to open, so it would be nice if that were fixed. And if you’re planning a longer stay and intend to cook your own meals, the kitchen needs an upgrade. There isn’t much kitchen equipment, and the frying pan has seen better days. Drew told us to buy anything we needed, but we didn't have time.
we enjoyed our stay and would happily come again.

Excellent value place in a fantastic location right in the heart of the action in Beyoglu. Very spacious and comfortable flat with all the amenities we needed. Responsive and flexible host who kindly arranged bag storage on the day of our departure. The road outside the bedrooms is a little noisy but it’s the price to pay for such a great central location. Recommended.

The place was very clean and comfortable. The wifi is great, easy to work from home. The location is great and close to good restaurants and cafes but still on a quieter street. The kitchen has the bare minimum basics, so you can cook but not extravagantly, also there’s no microwave.
Overall it was great and I would stay again!

description:
Enjoy staying in this strategic home where you and your family will be close to everything
This apartment is located in a modern building within a vibrant and lively residential neighborhood in Bakirkoy.
Its unique location is close to the sea promenade, green gardens, and Atakoy Marina yacht club.
Just steps away, you'll find a street full of shops and cafes, and at the end of it is Bakirkoy Station, making it easy to get around the city. You can also walk within 10 minutes to two of the most popular shopping malls in the area
Capacity Mall & Carousel Mall

‏

reviews.text: The apartment was clean and comfortable, corresponding to the photos by 100%. All the equipment functioned well. Air conditioning in every room is a huge benefit. Check-in and check-out were fast and convenient. We would like to thank Ali for the hospitality!

We had a great stay at Ali’s apartment. The place was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed. Ali was very helpful, responsive, and always available whenever we needed assistance. The location was also excellent, with easy access to shopping malls, the coast, and plenty of great restaurants nearby. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

We enjoyed our stay here. The place was comfortable, and in a good location. It was easy to get around Istanbul, and the host was nice and helpful whenever we needed anything. Everything was just as described, and we had a good experience overall. We would definitely stay here again!

Very nice, roomy unit with incredible AC which was a lifesaver given the hot/ humid weather. The location is good but do expect some basic street noise (typical for Istanbul). The only odd thing was having to buy our own refills of toilet paper from the market that was nearby. I would definitely recommend this place to family and friends. Thank you Ali and Nazli. Both were very attentive and responsive from beginning to end.

Konumu bulmak bizim için çok kolay oldu. Nazlı Hanım da bu konuda bize çok yardımcı oldu. Ev oldukça temiz ve düzenliydi. İki yatak odası ve iki banyosu olması bizim için çok rahattı. Koltuklar konforluydu ve ayrıca ekstra yatak da vardı.
Evin yaklaşık 50 metre yakınında Şok market ve fırın bulunuyor. Bir sonraki sokakta ise Bakırköy Çarşısı’na ulaşabilirsiniz. Özellikle akşamları yürüyüş yapmak, gezmek ve vakit geçirmek için harika bir bölge. Yakınında büyük alışveriş merkezleri, birçok ünlü marka ve Bakırköy’ün yer altı çarşısı da bulunuyor.
Daire ana caddeye çok yakın olduğu için toplu taşıma açısından da oldukça avantajlı. Caddenin diğer tarafında ise güzel bir sahil ve çok sayıda kafe bulunuyor.
Konumu, temizliği ve rahatlığıyla kesinlikle tavsiye edebileceğimiz bir konaklama oldu. Ali bey ve Nazlı Hanım'a ilgisi ve yardımları için ayrıca teşekkür ederiz.

description: The building is brand new and located at one of the most central locations in the city. You can take the ferry directly to the historical city centre Sultanahmet or hang out in the neighbourhood, Kadıköy, which is one of the most colorful and popular areas in Istanbul. Since this is a brand new building it is fully earthquake proof, complying with all the up to date requirements.

reviews.text:
Great stay – highly recommended!
We stayed for five days and felt very comfortable. The location is excellent – just a 5-minute walk to the ferry terminal and shuttle bus stops to both Istanbul and Sabiha Gökçen airports (Havaist & Havabus).
The neighborhood is quiet, with plenty of mini-markets, restaurants, and cafés just a few minutes away. The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and had everything we needed. It’s on the 3rd floor, but there’s a small elevator in the building.
Suat was our main contact – was very friendly, responsive, and always available to help – great communication! He's almost always available in the office on the ground floor.
Only minor downside: the bedroom doesn’t have its own air conditioning (AC), just in the living room. So you need to keep the bedroom door open to get some cool air from the AC in the living room. It was fine for us, but an AC in the bedroom would be perfect for hot summer days.

Great experience throughout my stay. The location is great as it is walkable and close to the ferry station and metro and close enough to the heart of the action in Kadikoy but in a more quiet neighborhood without all of the late night noise.
The building is secure and everything is new. Great to have elevator in this part of the city. The apartment had everything I needed and was really clean.
Great and responsive hosts.

It was great experience! Hosts are very friendly and helpful, apartment clean, cute and matches the photos! Location is comfortable, it easy to get anything you want, and go anywhere you need. Definitely will recommend this place and will come back! Thank you!

Cem Arda's place is so great, the location is very close to the bus and ferry stations and both are very easy to reach by walking, there are also many restaurants around and it is not far from the center of Kadikoy. The place itself is very comfortable, clean and private. And the most helpful is Suat, we were helped a lot with his smooth and informative communication. We were even allowed to check in early. I will definitely come back here if I have plan to go to Kadikoy.

Nice place in Kadikoy (Asian side) conveniently close to metro and ferry. Ideal for couples/single tourists in Istanbul. Room was clean and comfortable, everything that is needed is there. Host very nice and responsive, there is basically a lobby service like in a hotel :) I had a wonderful stay and will do again in future hopefully

description:
Our apartment is within walking distance of all entertainment venues, touristic and historical buildings, shopping centers, and is in a location where you can easily reach anywhere you want. It is possible to reach the metro, bus, tram and ferry stations in a simple way.

Our flat has 1 room. There is a king size bed in the bedroom and a sofa bedin the living room. This apartment also has private courtyard

reviews.text: This is a good place and the host Ataćan is great, very responsive and helpful. Place is exactly as described and clean. Neighborhood is not the best in Istanbul but location in the city is nice. Public transport, groceries, small eateries etc are all available around. Almost all attractions of the city are accessible by public transport. Amenities are sufficient. Bathroom is a bit small. Overall, this place is worth the money you pay for it.

it is very good apt and all is with walking distance. and the host is always ready to help and response.
it is super close to Taksim.
the apt is very clean and comfortable and all equipped.
thansk foe all your support!

I spent a month here and I loved it. Atacan is the nicest and he went out of his way to make my stay as comfortable as possible. The apartment is new and clean and the shower is amazing. I definitely recommend it. Betul is also very responsive.

The suite has everything you need for a short stay. The host was really helpful and kind, the check-in and check-out was pretty simple and easy. The internet was very good. Some people complain about this neighbourhood, and indeed it is not the most pretty neighbourhood in Istanbul, but we felt safe walking around and everyone in the neighbourhood was friendly.

This was by far the worse and most dangerous place I’ve stayed in my life. There were drug users and homeless people right outside the apartment, most were there till 4am in the morning. The place in itself was extremely dirty and dusty, really bad for my allergies. The bathroom lots of random hairs lying around. And the kitchen was a mess.

description: Close to anywhere at the center of the city

reviews.text:
The apartment is the exactly what airbnb is about. The place felt lived in but in a really comforting and familiar way. Lots of stylish and individual touches which makes it feel that you are staying at a friend's rather than a strangers.
The location is perfect, easy to get around the centre of Istanbul and Paris could not have been more helpful or accommodating. He was on hand with tips and advice and took the time to understand what you were looking for or interested in and research before making a suggestion.
Can't recommend Paris and his lovely apartment highly enough. I would deffinetly stay there again.

We came here for 4 nights over the new year's, and absolutely loved it. The flat is gorgeous and truly well located near the main tram line and Taksim square. The two rooms were very comfortable and warm (I say this because it snowed that week - quite the experience). Halis was a wonderful host, very helpful and always available, thank you again!

The apartment is really nice and cozy, centrally located, close to tram station. Shiny and made with great taste it will definitely make you feel like home. The host is a great guy willing to help you out about everything and anytime. His recommendations are not to be missed. Funny and full of positive energy Halis and his cat Kimo are the best company to hang out with. Thanx for such a great hospitality and for making our vacations special!

We've stayed at Paris (actually his name Halis) apartment for 3 night and I've not seen such great host! Kimo is definitely gives you ability to feel like you're are almost at home and Halis could give really good advices on where to go/what to see and where you shouldn't. In our case he told us not to celebrate the New Year at Taksim square and that was really good advice (based on comments from people we have met). We really like the cafe Halis advised too (Arada cafe). Try their breakfast))))
The apartment are really great. Everything you need is there. It's not far from Taksim square (about 10 mins walk) and about 7 mins walk to the tram which can bring you to the old city in 10 mins. Actually if you like you can take your time and walk there by your own.

Paris is best host I ever met. Both organization and welcome were great (thank you for the wine - we spent great night savouring;) And when we had to go to the airport and had problem with getting a Taxi, Paris took us to the bus station where we could take the airport rout. Kimo is very nice and it was good to have him around as well:)

I highly recommending this place, near by mall of istanbul and 212 outlet, clean and beautiful flat, amazing view from the 16th floor, security and free parking.
